articles.title: Lightfoot: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Exact, Model-Free Document Deletion
articles.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) improves multi-hop question answering, but deployed systems face two costs that research comparisons rarely measure: building the graph, and removing documents from it. We present Lightfoot, a GraphRAG system in which every entity, link, fact and synonym edge is a deterministic function of per-passage extractions carrying chunk-level provenance. Indexing makes one language-model call per passage, retrieval makes none, and deleting a document is a database operation with no model calls. On the full 11,402-passage MuSiQue corpus we verify that, after deleting 10% of the documents, the graph is identical to a fresh index of the surviving documents. We compare Lightfoot with HippoRAG 2, LightRAG and fast-graphrag under identical extraction, answer and embedding models on MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA. Lightfoot builds the cheapest index on all three datasets, 26-31% below HippoRAG 2 and 3-6x below LightRAG and fast-graphrag. Against HippoRAG 2 it is significantly better on MuSiQue retrieval (+2.8 points recall@5 and +4.3 recall@10 on a held-out split) and on HotpotQA answers (+7.7 points exact match), and significantly worse on 2WikiMultiHopQA (-3.9 recall@2, -8.4 F1). Deleting the same documents took LightRAG 2,187 model calls and 3.7 hours; fast-graphrag has no deletion path. Code and per-question results: https://github.com/udayallu-ml/Lightfoot-GraphRAG
articles.titleCn: Lightfoot：基于精确、无模型文档删除的图检索增强生成
articles.abstractCn: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）提升了多跳问答能力，但部署系统面临两个研究对比中很少衡量的成本：构建图和从图中移除文档。我们提出了Lightfoot，一个GraphRAG系统，其中每个实体、链接、事实和同义词边都是基于每段文本提取的确定性函数，且携带块级溯源信息。索引过程为每段文本调用一次语言模型，检索过程不调用，删除文档仅需数据库操作而无模型调用。在完整的11,402段MuSiQue语料库上，我们验证删除10%文档后，图与剩余文档的新索引完全相同。我们在MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA和HotpotQA数据集上，使用相同的提取、答案和嵌入模型，将Lightfoot与HippoRAG 2、LightRAG和fast-graphrag进行比较。Lightfoot在三个数据集上构建了最经济的索引，比HippoRAG 2低26-31%，比LightRAG和fast-graphrag低3-6倍。在MuSiQue检索上，Lightfoot显著优于HippoRAG 2（在保留分割集上recall@5提升2.8分，recall@10提升4.3分），在HotpotQA答案上（精确匹配提升7.7分），但在2WikiMultiHopQA上表现显著较差（recall@2下降3.9分，F1下降8.4分）。删除相同文档时，Lightfoot需要2,187次模型调用和3.7小时；fast-graphrag没有删除路径。代码和每题结果：https://github.com/udayallu-ml/Lightfoot-GraphRAG

articles.title: Open Problems in Chatbots and Mental Health
articles.abstract: General-purpose chatbots are increasingly used for emotional and mental health support. They can be useful, but issues such as sycophancy, reinforcement of delusional beliefs, and poor crisis response create risks that are difficult for researchers to study and evaluate. In this paper, we review the most critical open problems for researchers and policymakers in the use of general-purpose chatbots and their effects on mental health. First, there are tractable problems in the controlled evaluation of chatbots: establishing the construct and ecological validity of evaluations, evaluating multi-turn interactions, and connecting evaluations to improvements in chatbot behavior. For example, conventional benchmarks that primarily rely on static datasets cannot establish chatbot safety, and novel simulation methods need validation. Second, researchers must connect their studies of chatbots and mental health to real-world evidence. This includes analyzing the chatbot products that AI companies and mental health practitioners have deployed, including their user interfaces and human review and escalation practices for user welfare concerns. However, clinical analysis opportunities afforded by real chat log data sharing are complicated by significant privacy concerns. Finally, we argue that researchers should take an active role in the construction and refinement of evidence-based policy through corporate and governmental decisions such as user protections, standards of care, protected access to user chat logs, data sharing between institutions, incident reporting, and post-deployment monitoring. Such behavioral evaluations, studies of real-world outcomes, and data governance depend on each other and must be addressed in tandem. We believe a coordinated research effort would have substantial real-world impact.
articles.titleCn: 聊天机器人和心理健康领域的开放性问题
articles.abstractCn: 通用聊天机器人在情感和心理健康支持方面的应用日益广泛。它们虽然有用，但谄媚、强化妄想信念以及危机应对能力不足等问题带来了研究者难以研究和评估的风险。本文综述了通用聊天机器人在心理健康领域应用中研究者及政策制定者面临的最关键开放问题。首先，在聊天机器人的受控评估中存在可解决的问题：建立评估的结构效度和生态效度、评估多轮交互以及将评估与聊天机器人行为的改进联系起来。例如，主要依赖静态数据集的传统基准无法验证聊天机器人的安全性，而新的模拟方法需要验证。其次，研究者必须将他们对聊天机器人和心理健康的研究与真实世界证据联系起来。这包括分析人工智能公司和心理健康从业者部署的聊天机器人产品，包括其用户界面以及针对用户福利问题的用户审查和升级流程。然而，真实聊天日志数据共享带来的临床分析机会因重大的隐私问题而变得复杂。最后，我们认为研究者应积极参与基于证据的政策构建和改进，通过企业及政府的决策，如用户保护、护理标准、用户聊天日志的受保护访问、机构间数据共享、事件报告和部署后监控等。此类行为评估、真实世界结果研究以及数据治理相互依存，必须协同解决。我们相信，协调一致的研究努力将产生实质性的现实影响。

articles.title: Think or Remember: The Exchange Rate of Agentic Inference
articles.abstract: Agents built on reasoning models resend their growing transcript at every call. Two transacting parties, not the model, decide what that costs: the client keeps or edits messages; the server decides whether earlier reasoning returns in the prompt and what its cache reuses. We define a cost model whose counts match an instrumented engine exactly; the architecture charges $c$ per token processed and $β$ per pair attended. Their ratio $P^*=c/β$ is an exchange rate between thinking and remembering: per token, processing dominates below this context length, a thinking regime, and attention above it, a memory regime. A policy change has a mechanical cost, incurred even if the agent writes the same tokens, and a behavioral one: it writes different tokens, changing cost and outcome. Serving alone can flip which policy is cheaper: on recorded Qwen3-8B ScienceWorld runs, dropping earlier reasoning costs 1.74 times keeping it when the server reuses generated states and 0.34 times when it reuses nothing. In live reruns, dropping it cuts correct HotpotQA answers by 9-23 percentage points on four models, at lower point-estimate cost. Comparing context policies means comparing systems: architecture and serving set the cost of the history kept and the work it induces.
articles.titleCn: 思考或回忆：自主推理的汇率
articles.abstractCn: 基于推理模型的代理在每次调用时都会重新发送其不断增长的会话记录。是两个交易方，而不是模型本身，决定这些成本：客户端保留或编辑消息；服务器决定是否在提示中包含早期的推理结果，以及其缓存会重用哪些内容。我们定义了一个成本模型，其计数与经过监控的引擎完全匹配；该架构按每个处理的token收费$c$，按每对关注的token收费$β$。它们的比率$P^*=c/β$是思考和记忆之间的交换率：在低于此上下文长度的token下，处理占主导地位，属于思考模式；而在高于此长度的token上，注意力占主导地位，属于记忆模式。政策变更会产生机械成本，即使代理写入相同的token也会产生，以及行为成本：它写入不同的token，从而改变成本和结果。仅提供服务就能翻转哪种政策更便宜：在对Qwen3-8B ScienceWorld的记录运行中，当服务器重用生成的状态时，丢弃早期推理的成本是保留它的1.74倍；当服务器不重用时，成本是保留它的0.34倍。在实时重运行中，对四个模型而言，丢弃早期推理使HotpotQA的正确答案减少了9-23个百分点，但点估计成本更低。比较上下文政策意味着比较系统：架构和服务设定了保留的历史成本及其引发的工作成本。

articles.title: DM-Call: Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling with Cumulative Verification Feedback
articles.abstract: Reliable function calling requires Large Language Models (LLMs) to select appropriate functions and generate arguments consistent with user intent. However, syntactically valid calls may still be semantically incorrect due to inappropriate function selection or mismatched arguments. In this paper, we propose Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling (DM-Call), a framework that combines local schema validation with separate decision-model verification of function selection and argument correctness. For rejected candidates, DM-Call accumulates verification probabilities, binary judgments, and schema errors across attempts. A hybrid feedback representation further combines numerical probabilities with verbal correctness labels to guide iterative refinement without executing external tools. Extensive evaluation across BFCL and API-Bank (first-call) demonstrates DM-Call boosts function-calling accuracy versus direct generation, at modest additional cost.
articles.titleCn: 基于决策模型的累积验证反馈函数调用
articles.abstractCn: 可靠的函数调用需要大型语言模型（LLMs）选择合适的函数并生成与用户意图一致的参数。然而，由于函数选择不当或参数不匹配，语法上有效的调用可能仍然在语义上不正确。在本文中，我们提出了决策模型引导的函数调用（DM-Call）框架，该框架结合了本地模式验证与独立的决策模型验证函数选择和参数正确性。对于被拒绝的候选，DM-Call在多次尝试中累积验证概率、二元判断和模式错误。混合反馈表示进一步结合数值概率和语言正确性标签，以指导迭代优化而不执行外部工具。在BFCL和API-Bank（首次调用）上的广泛评估表明，与直接生成相比，DM-Call提升了函数调用准确性，且额外成本适中。

articles.title: SWEET: Mitigating Spurious Feature Reliance in LLM Reasoning via Weight Editing
articles.abstract: Reasoning in large language models can be disrupted by simple input perturbations (e.g. adding irrelevant distractors), suggesting reliance on spurious correlations. Identifying and suppressing the spurious features involved in long chain-of-thought reasoning remains challenging. We introduce Spurious-feature WEight EdiTing (SWEET), a training-free method that combines counterfactual interventions with mechanistic interpretability to identify and suppress spurious-features. SWEET extracts token- and sequence-level behavioral directions from activation contrasts between original problems and their counterfactual variants - capturing local and global patterns of spurious reasoning. It then localizes the responsible MLP neurons and attention heads and suppresses their contributions along these directions through weight edits. Using only 20 original-counterfactual pairs for direction extraction, SWEET improves accuracy by an average of 11.8 percentage points on perturbed inputs and 2 points on original inputs across five open-weight reasoning models and five reasoning benchmarks. It also reduces the relative gap between original and perturbed accuracies from 17.6% to 2.5%. Analyses identify two recurring forms of spurious reasoning, i.e. over-integrating irrelevant conditions and overthinking, and provide mechanistic evidence that SWEET improves reasoning robustness by suppressing both behavioral directions.
articles.titleCn: SWEET：通过权重编辑减轻大语言模型推理中的虚假特征依赖
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的推理可能受到简单输入扰动（例如添加无关干扰项）的破坏，这表明其依赖虚假关联。识别并抑制在长链式思维推理中涉及的虚假特征仍然具有挑战性。我们引入了虚假特征权重编辑（SWEET）方法，这是一种无需训练的方法，结合了反事实干预和机理可解释性，以识别并抑制虚假特征。SWEET从原始问题及其反事实变体的激活对比中提取出标记级和序列级的行為方向——捕捉虚假推理的局部和全局模式。然后，它定位负责的多层感知器神经元和注意力头，并通过权重编辑沿这些方向抑制它们的贡献。仅使用20对原始-反事实对进行方向提取，SWEET在五个开放权重推理模型和五个推理基准上，对扰动输入的平均准确率提高了11.8个百分点，对原始输入提高了2个百分点。它还将原始输入与扰动输入之间的相对差距从17.6%减少到2.5%。分析确定了两种常见的虚假推理形式，即过度整合无关条件和过度思考，并提供了机理证据，表明SWEET通过抑制这两种行为方向提高了推理鲁棒性。

articles.title: When Safety Becomes An Outlier: Understanding the Retention of LLM Safety Behaviors
articles.abstract: Safety-aligned large language models often lose their safety behaviors after fine-tuning, even when safety data are included. While this fragility is well documented, its underlying cause remains unclear. In this paper, we propose that formulaic refusal strings can function as outlier modes: narrow, weakly grounded response patterns that are easy to fit but vulnerable to subsequent updates. Controlled experiments support this account: fixed refusals are acquired much like arbitrary constant strings, in contrast to prompt-grounded natural responses. Motivated by these findings, we introduce Naturalness-Enhanced Safety Targets (NEST), a safety alignment framework that improves safety retention by constructing natural, context-aware safety targets that keep safety responses within the model's existing output distribution and grounded in semantics. We instantiate NEST in both supervised and preference-based alignment settings, using perplexity under the original model as a proxy for distributional support. Across multiple models and alignment regimes, natural safety targets improve both immediate safety and its retention under continued fine-tuning without sacrificing helpfulness. These findings suggest a practical principle for more durable safety alignment: construct safety targets that draw on the model's existing language capabilities and remain grounded in the meaning of each request.
articles.titleCn: 当安全变得异常：理解大型语言模型安全行为的留存
articles.abstractCn: 安全对齐的大型语言模型在微调后常常会失去其安全行为，即使包含了安全数据也是如此。虽然这种脆弱性已被广泛记录，但其根本原因仍然不明确。在本文中，我们提出公式化的拒绝字符串可以充当异常模式：狭窄且基础薄弱的响应模式，这些模式易于拟合，但容易受到后续更新的影响。受控实验支持这一解释：固定的拒绝与任意常量字符串的获取方式相似，而与基于提示的自然响应形成对比。基于这些发现，我们引入了自然增强安全目标（NEST），这是一个安全对齐框架，通过构建自然且上下文感知的安全目标来提高安全保留率，这些目标使安全响应保持在模型的现有输出分布内，并基于语义。我们在监督和基于偏好的对齐设置中实例化了NEST，使用原始模型下的困惑度作为分布支持的代理。在多个模型和对齐机制中，自然的安全目标在不牺牲有用性的情况下，提高了即时的安全性和持续微调下的安全保留率。这些发现为更持久的安全对齐提供了一条实用原则：构建安全目标，使其借鉴模型现有的语言能力，并保持与每个请求含义的关联。

articles.title: Can small transformers learn the language of Coxeter groups?
articles.abstract: The field of mechanistic interpretability is well-suited to collaborative projects between mathematicians and AI researchers. This work describes one such project. We trained a small transformer to learn the language of the Coxeter group affine A2, best known as the symmetries of the tiling of the Euclidean plane by equilateral triangles. We then formulated and proved a word-theoretic conjecture about affine A2 after observing the attention patterns of the trained model.
articles.comment: 13 pages, 13 figures, accepted as a poster at the 6th workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI; NeurIPS 2026, Atlanta; This version is updated from the camera-ready version which can be found at https://mathai-2026.github.io/cfp/ and https://openreview.net/forum?id=lYImtIt4tA
articles.titleCn: 小型Transformer能否学习 Coxeter群的语料？
articles.abstractCn: 机制可解释性领域非常适合数学家和人工智能研究者之间的合作项目。这项工作描述了一个这样的项目。我们训练了一个小型Transformer来学习Coxeter群仿射A2的语言，它最广为人知的是作为等边三角形平铺欧几里得平面的对称性。然后，在观察训练模型的注意力模式后，我们提出了并证明了一个关于仿射A2的词理论猜想。

articles.title: Gendered Misclassification from Surname-Based Race Imputation
articles.abstract: Researchers increasingly estimate political behavior based on race and gender from voter files, where race is imputed from surnames and geography. This only works where surnames suggest group membership, an assumption violated where surnames follow norms around marriage. Imputation is therefore biased against women who adopt their husband's surname, especially those who racially inter-marry, an outcome itself endogenous to partisanship. Using six US states recording self-reported race, I show that imputation is less accurate for Asian and Hispanic women, particularly those sharing the surname of a partner of another race, who differ politically from other women of their race. This violates assumptions behind downstream inference approaches, which nearly double the gender gap in partisanship among Asian voters. I derive an expression showing the bias is largest where a group is small. Using maiden rather than marriage-adopted surnames in North Carolina raises accuracy up to fourfold for women married across racial lines. Recovering maiden surnames, or omitting the married surname, removes much of the bias. In a national replication of a study of gender gaps in turnout, the correction more than triples the gap among Asian voters. In Lebanon, where wives register in their husband's locality, the error enters through geography.
articles.titleCn: 基于姓氏的种族推断导致的性别错误分类
articles.abstractCn: 研究人员越来越多地根据种族和性别从选民档案中估计政治行为，其中种族信息是根据姓氏和地理位置推断的。这种方法只有在姓氏能暗示群体归属的情况下才有效，但在姓氏遵循婚姻规范的情况下，这一假设就会被违背。因此，推断方法对采用丈夫姓氏的女性存在偏见，尤其是那些跨种族通婚的女性，而这一结果本身又与党派认同具有内生性关联。通过分析六个记录自我报告种族信息的美国州的数据，我表明，推断方法对亚裔和西班牙裔女性不够准确，特别是那些与不同种族的伴侣共享姓氏的女性，她们在政治观点上与其他同种族女性存在差异。这违反了下游推断方法背后的假设，导致亚裔选民中的性别差距几乎翻倍。我推导出一个表达式，表明当群体规模较小时，偏见最为严重。在北卡罗来纳州，使用婚前姓氏而非婚后采用的姓氏，使跨种族婚姻女性的准确性提高了四倍。恢复婚前姓氏或省略婚后姓氏，可以消除大部分偏见。在一项关于投票性别差距的全国性重复研究中，修正措施使亚裔选民中的差距扩大了三倍。在黎巴嫩，由于妻子在丈夫所在地注册，错误信息是通过地理位置引入的。

articles.title: DeepFinance: Can AI Diligence a $100MM Deal?
articles.abstract: Existing evaluations of AI models on high-finance work focus on retrieving answers from financial documents and producing numerically correct outputs. Real private equity (PE) and investment banking (IB) work also depends on choosing between conflicting sources, making sound assumptions, and keeping every step auditable. We introduce DeepFinance, an ultra long-horizon benchmark of 21 end-to-end PE and IB tasks that take a human professional an average of 27.1 hours. Each task pairs a request with a data room averaging 19 files and is graded against an average of 84 expert-written rubric criteria covering output, workflow, and judgment. We evaluate 22 model configurations, each in its native agent harness. The best configuration, GPT-6 Astra with max reasoning, satisfies 57.6% of rubric criteria, and the top four configurations are not statistically distinguishable. Frontier models often calculate correctly from the wrong inputs and find decision-relevant evidence without acting on it.
articles.titleCn: DeepFinance：人工智能能否尽职调查一桩价值1亿美元的交易？
articles.abstractCn: 现有对高金融领域AI模型的评估主要关注从金融文档中检索答案并生成数值正确的输出。而真实的私募股权（PE）和投资银行（IB）工作也依赖于在相互冲突的来源之间进行选择、做出合理的假设以及确保每一步都可供审计。我们介绍了DeepFinance，这是一个超长期金融基准，包含21项端到端的PE和IB任务，平均需要人类专业人士27.1小时完成。每项任务都配对一个包含约19个文件的数据室，并根据涵盖输出、工作流程和判断的84个专家编写的评分标准进行评估。我们评估了22种模型配置，每种配置都在其原生代理框架中运行。最佳配置为GPT-6 Astra（最大推理能力），满足57.6%的评分标准，前四名配置在统计上没有显著区别。前沿模型常常从错误输入中正确计算，并在未采取行动的情况下发现与决策相关的证据。

articles.title: Pole or Vector? Encoders Capture Bangla Compound Verbs, but LLMs Read Them Literally
articles.abstract: In Bangla, a main verb is often followed by one of a small set of vector verbs. These verbs lose their own meaning and add a shade of meaning instead, such as completion. For example, likhe phello means that someone finished writing, not that they wrote and threw something. The same two verbs can also describe two separate events, so only the context shows which meaning is meant. This makes compound verbs a hard test of how language models handle multiword expressions. We present BanglaCV-Probe, a benchmark of 17 vector verbs with 1,044 minimal pairs, 204 entailment items and 197 pairs of correct and incorrect combinations, all checked by native speakers. We test 26 models (encoders, LLMs and translation systems) on four skills: telling the two meanings apart internally, understanding what a vector adds, preferring correct combinations and keeping the vector's meaning in translation. Probes on five encoders tell the two meanings apart and still reach up to 93% accuracy when trained on pairs without surface cues. Prompted models rarely use this knowledge. Entailment accuracy stays between 59% and 81%. Several LLMs answer Yes or No to almost every item, and nine of ten models miss that someone who ate up the rice left none. Most instruction-tuned LLMs translate vectors literally in 15-20% of vector sentences and in up to 55% for mora (die). On correct combinations, a small Bangla-only model (88%) matches BLOOM-7B1 (87%) and both beat Qwen2.5-7B (74%). Data and code: https://github.com/ashuvo25/Pole_OR_Vector
articles.titleCn: 极点还是向量？编码器能够捕捉孟加拉语复合动词，但大型语言模型却逐字读取它们
articles.abstractCn: 在孟加拉语中，一个主要动词后面经常跟着一小系列向量动词。这些动词会失去自身的含义，转而增加一层含义，例如完成。例如，“likhe phello”表示某人完成了写作，而不是表示他写了东西然后扔掉了。同样的两个动词也可以描述两个独立的事件，所以只有上下文才能表明意图的含义。这使得复合动词成为测试语言模型如何处理多词表达的一个难题。我们提出了BanglaCV-Probe，这是一个包含17个向量动词的基准，其中有1,044对最小对、204个蕴含项和197对正确和错误的组合，所有内容均由母语人士验证。我们在四个技能上测试了26个模型（编码器、大型语言模型和翻译系统）：内部区分两种含义、理解向量添加的含义、偏好正确的组合以及在翻译中保持向量的含义。五个编码器的探测任务能够区分两种含义，并且在未经表面线索的成对训练中仍能达到高达93%的准确率。提示模型很少使用这种知识。蕴含项的准确率保持在59%到81%之间。几个大型语言模型几乎对每个项目都回答“是”或“否”，十之九的模型没有注意到吃掉米饭的人没有剩下任何。大多数指令微调的大型语言模型在15-20%的向量句子中逐字翻译向量，而在55%的音节（die）句子中也是如此。在正确的组合中，一个小型孟加拉语模型（88%）与BLOOM-7B1（87%）相当，两者都优于Qwen2.5-7B（74%）。数据和代码：https://github.com/ashuvo25/Pole_OR_Vector

articles.title: SCorPion: A Strategic, Controllable and Personified Conversational Companion
articles.abstract: Fixed prompt-based language models face challenges in open-domain conversations, where versatile topics require different expert advice or demonstrations to maximize their universal performance. Motivated by the dynamic prompt studies in language generation, we extract different chatting strategies from varied forms of text corpus, which steer the language model to different styles based on human principles. We design and deploy a conversational companion called SCorPion, which uses GraphRAG to extract and summarize the knowledge graph globally, yield community-summarized strategies, and produce query-focused optimal strategies. SCorPion has strategic thinking, yields personified and stylized responses, and can be controlled by explicit factors. Code and further results can be found in https://bachozean.github.io/scorpion-page/.
articles.titleCn: SCorPion：一个策略性、可控且拟人化的对话伴侣
articles.abstractCn: 基于提示的语言模型在开放域对话中面临挑战，因为多样化的主题需要不同的专家建议或演示来最大化其通用性能。受语言生成中动态提示研究的启发，我们从各种形式的文本语料库中提取不同的聊天策略，根据人类原则引导语言模型采用不同的风格。我们设计并部署了一个名为SCorPion的对话助手，该助手使用GraphRAG从全局层面提取和总结知识图谱，生成社区总结的策略，并产出以查询为中心的最优策略。SCorPion具有策略性思维，能够生成个性化且风格化的回复，并且可以通过显式因素进行控制。代码和进一步的结果可以在https://bachozean.github.io/scorpion-page/找到。

articles.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training
articles.abstract: How little of a pretrained large language model (LLM) has to change for it to acquire new capabilities? We find that zeroing fewer than 0.05% of its weights, with no other modification, matches full fine-tuning (FFT) at scale across three LLM post-training regimes: reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy distillation. Our method, Deletion Tuning, learns a binary mask over the gate projection of transformer blocks. Two practical advantages follow: the trained mask is hundreds to thousands of times smaller than the corresponding FFT checkpoint, and Deletion Tuning forgets far less, which addresses a central challenge in continual learning. Under reinforcement learning, its prior-task accuracy stays near the base level while FFT, LoRA, and random sparse fine-tuning lose up to 5.4 points. To understand why masking alone suffices, we analyze the geometry of the learned weight changes under reinforcement learning using stable rank, spectrum drift, and principal-weight overlap. Compared with LoRA and random sparse fine-tuning, Deletion Tuning is closest to FFT across the three measures.
articles.titleCn: 删除LLM训练后权重的惊人效果
articles.abstractCn: 要让预训练的大型语言模型（LLM）获得新能力，其权重需要改变多少？我们发现，仅将不到0.05%的权重置零，且不进行其他修改，就能在三种LLM后训练模式下实现与大规模全量微调（FFT）相当的效果：带可验证奖励的强化学习、监督微调和策略蒸馏。我们的方法——删除微调（Deletion Tuning）——学习在Transformer块的门控投影上生成一个二进制掩码。由此带来两个实际优势：训练好的掩码比相应的FFT检查点小数百到数千倍，且删除微调遗忘得较少，从而解决了持续学习中的一个核心挑战。在强化学习下，其先验任务准确率保持在基准水平附近，而FFT、LoRA和随机稀疏微调则最多下降5.4个百分点。为了理解为何仅掩码就足够，我们使用稳定秩、频谱漂移和主权重重叠分析了强化学习下学习到的权重变化的几何结构。与LoRA和随机稀疏微调相比，删除微调在这三个指标上最接近FFT。

articles.title: KeyASRBench: Measuring Whole-Phrase Keyword Preservation in Real-World ASR
articles.abstract: Public automatic speech recognition (ASR) benchmarks increasingly report low sequence error rates, yet production systems still use hotword lists, contextual biasing, retrieval, and post-correction. This motivates a complementary question: does a transcript preserve selected names, products, technical terms, versions, and relational phrases? We present KeyASRBench, a bilingual pilot that operationalizes occurrence-based Keyword Error Rate (KER) over frozen whole-phrase annotations. The 10-hour model-conditioned challenge set contains 1,501 Chinese and English clips with 4,723 keyword occurrences. Across five locally inferred checkpoints and two official API systems, language-specific MER/WER ranges from 5.31% to 12.91%, while KER ranges from 13.61% to 33.81%. A disjoint 30-minute model-blind control yields KER of 10.65%-27.31%. The control confirms that selected-phrase errors extend beyond challenge-set selection.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Bilingual ASR evaluation with a 10-hour model-conditioned challenge set and a disjoint 30-minute model-blind control
articles.titleCn: KeyASRBench：衡量真实世界语音识别中全词组关键词保留情况
articles.abstractCn: 公共自动语音识别（ASR）基准测试越来越多地报告低序列错误率，但生产系统仍然使用唤醒词列表、上下文偏差、检索和后修正。这促使了一个补充问题：转录是否保留了选定的名称、产品、技术术语、版本和关系短语？我们提出了KeyASRBench，一个双语试点，将基于出现次数的关键词错误率（KER）在冻结的整句标注上实现。10小时的模型条件挑战集包含1501个中文和英文片段，有4723个关键词出现。在五个本地推断的检查点和两个官方API系统上，特定语言的中位错误率（MER）/词错误率（WER）范围在5.31%到12.91%，而KER范围在13.61%到33.81%。一个分离的30分钟模型盲控制产生KER为10.65%-27.31%。控制实验证实，选定短语错误超出了挑战集的选择范围。

articles.title: MultiTurnRoute: A Platform for Building and Evaluating Multi-Turn LLM Routers
articles.abstract: In a multi-turn conversation, the choice of language model at one turn can affect which model should answer the next. The selected model's reply shapes the context for the next query, and its cached prompt prefix can reduce the cost of using that model again. We introduce MultiTurnRoute, a platform for building and evaluating multi-turn LLM routers. A shared interface gives built-in and user-defined routers the current query, dialogue history, and an estimate of each model's reusable prefix length. Our routing algorithm, Chain-of-Route (CoR), uses a learned gate over recent and recurrent dialogue history to predict response quality and estimates cost from each model's reusable prefix. MultiTurnRoute Arena ranks routers on recorded conversations and compares session quality and cost in interactive runs where a simulated user responds to each reply. On a benchmark drawn from WildChat and LMSYS-Chat-1M with per-turn quality annotations for five LLMs, CoR reduces the normalized cost required to match the strongest model's quality by up to 20.3% relative to the strongest routing baseline, while matching or improving peak response quality.
articles.titleCn: 多轮路由：构建和评估多轮大型语言模型路由的平台
articles.abstractCn: 在多轮对话中，每一轮选择的语言模型可能会影响下一轮应答哪个模型。所选模型的回复会塑造下一轮查询的上下文，其缓存的提示前缀可以降低再次使用该模型时的成本。我们介绍了MultiTurnRoute，一个用于构建和评估多轮LLM路由器的平台。一个共享接口为内置和用户定义的路由器提供当前查询、对话历史以及每个模型可重用前缀长度的估计值。我们的路由算法Chain-of-Route (CoR) 使用一个学习到的门控机制，基于近期和循环对话历史来预测回复质量，并从每个模型的可重用前缀中估计成本。MultiTurnRoute Arena根据记录的对话对路由器进行排名，并在模拟用户对每个回复进行应答的交互运行中比较会话质量和成本。在一个从WildChat和LMSYS-Chat-1M中抽取的基准测试中，该基准测试包含五个LLM的每轮质量标注，CoR相对于最强的路由基线，将匹配最强模型质量所需的归一化成本降低了高达20.3%，同时匹配或提升了峰值回复质量。

articles.title: Simple Test-Time Refinement for Plot-to-Code Generation via Visual-Code Diagnostics
articles.abstract: Plot-to-code generation has been greatly advanced by recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing studies mainly focus on one-pass generation or iterative sampling guided by verifier-based filtering, which does not align with the typical human programming workflow of generate first, then iteratively error-location and fix. This naturally motivates a test-time refinement paradigm for plot-to-code generation. In this work, we present the first study on plot-to-code generation via iterative test-time refinement. We propose a Visual-Code Diagnostics framework that enables refinement through visual feedback from source code. Specifically, we first categorize generation errors into four coarse-grained types, and then train lightweight discriminators to recognize and localize these errors based on the rendered visual outputs and corresponding code. Unlike traditional compiler- or debugger-based verification, our approach performs iterative refinement guided by one diagnostics system, enabling more effective semantic and visual correction during test time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves generation quality across diverse generators and significantly outperforms strong test-time scaling baselines.
articles.titleCn: 基于视觉代码诊断的绘图到代码生成简单测试时细化
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）极大地推动了故事板到代码的生成技术。然而，现有研究主要集中于单次生成或由验证器过滤引导的迭代采样，这与人类典型的编程工作流程——先生成，再迭代定位错误并修复——并不一致。这自然地催生了对故事板到代码生成技术的测试时优化范式。在本工作中，我们首次研究了通过迭代测试时优化进行故事板到代码的生成。我们提出了一种视觉-代码诊断框架，该框架通过源代码的视觉反馈实现优化。具体而言，我们首先将生成错误分为四种粗粒度类型，然后基于渲染的视觉输出和相应的代码，训练轻量级判别器来识别和定位这些错误。与传统的基于编译器或调试器的验证方法不同，我们的方法通过一个诊断系统进行迭代优化，从而在测试时实现更有效的语义和视觉校正。大量实验表明，我们的方法在各种生成器上始终提高了生成质量，并显著优于强大的测试时扩展基线。

articles.title: CompAIssionate Other: Identity Assumptions in LLM Responses to Distress
articles.abstract: Individuals experiencing suicidal ideation (SI) or psychological distress may disclose their social identities when seeking support from LLMs. Attending to identity-related stressors can be important for providing contextually appropriate and empathetic support. However, disclosing an identity does not necessarily mean that it is a cause of distress. In this work, we audit how LLMs interpret distress through disclosed identities. Using paired counterfactual interventions, we evaluate six LLMs across two SI and distress datasets, 16 identity and control conditions, and two prompting protocols. Our findings suggest that models can transform identity disclosures into explanatory narratives, attributing distress to presumed identity-related adversity. These assumptions frequently appear within otherwise empathetic responses, particularly when marginalized identities are disclosed. We contextualize our findings through the lens of compassionate othering to characterize these patterns as a form of harm in which empathetic responses impose identity-linked assumptions on individual suffering. These responses can misrepresent individuals' experiences by treating their identities as explanations for distress without supporting evidence. Our findings highlight the need to mitigate these harms by grounding interpretations of distress in individuals' disclosures and avoiding unsupported identity-linked assumptions.
articles.titleCn: 共情AI伙伴：大型语言模型对痛苦反应中的身份假设
articles.abstractCn: 经历自杀意念（SI）或心理困扰的个体在向大型语言模型（LLM）寻求支持时可能会透露其社会身份。关注与身份相关的压力源对于提供情境适宜且富有同情心的支持至关重要。然而，透露身份并不一定意味着它是困扰的原因。在这项工作中，我们审计了LLM如何通过透露的身份来解读困扰。通过使用配对反事实干预措施，我们在两个SI和困扰数据集、16个身份和控制条件以及两种提示协议下评估了六种LLM。我们的研究结果表明，模型可以将身份透露转化为解释性叙事，将困扰归因于假设的身份相关逆境。这些假设经常出现在其他富有同情心的回应中，尤其是在透露边缘化身份时。我们通过同情他者的视角来 contextualize我们的发现，将这些模式特征化为一种伤害形式，即富有同情心的回应在个体痛苦上强加了与身份相关的假设。这些回应在缺乏支持证据的情况下，通过将个体的身份视为困扰的解释来歪曲他们的经历。我们的研究结果表明，有必要通过将困扰的解释建立在个体的透露基础上并避免未经支持的与身份相关的假设来减轻这些危害。

articles.title: Evaluating Jev on Arabic: Comparing Decision Models and LLMs Across Arabic Tasks and Dialects
articles.abstract: How does Jev compare with other systems on Arabic tasks, and how does its performance change between Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and dialects? We evaluate 67 systems, including 47 decision models and 20 large language models (LLMs), on 43 tasks across 9 task families using a shared zero-shot protocol. The Arabic-focused frozen suite includes English controls in three parallel resources, which we also remove in a separate descriptive comparison. Jev 1.14.0 achieves a mean task-primary metric of 69.24 on a scale multiplied by 100, compared with 68.77 for Jev 1.13.0 and 71.81 for Gemma-4-31B, the highest-scoring system on this aggregate. Removing the recorded English controls, repeated cross-task items or both leaves the full system order unchanged. Relative performance and gains between Jev versions vary across task families. In content-matched comparisons within Jev 1.14.0, pooled dialect-minus-MSA accuracy gaps range from -7.94 to -0.35 percentage points across four datasets; dialect-specific results show larger variation, and SIB-200's source-clustered interval includes zero. Paired contrasts with Jev 1.13.0, Gemma-4-31B and Jais-2-8B show a larger Palestinian banking penalty for Jev 1.14.0 than for either LLM under simultaneous uncertainty; the other gap contrasts remain inconclusive. These descriptive findings show why aggregate scores should be read alongside task-family results, coverage and matched language comparisons. They do not establish a general model ranking for dialect robustness or explain the causes of the observed gaps.
articles.titleCn: 评估Jev对阿拉伯语的掌握：比较决策模型和大型语言模型在阿拉伯语任务和方言中的表现
articles.abstractCn: 杰夫（Jev）与其他系统在阿拉伯语任务上的比较如何，以及其性能在标准阿拉伯语（MSA）和方言之间的变化是怎样的？我们使用共享的零样本协议，在9个任务族中的43个任务上评估了67个系统，包括47个决策模型和20个大型语言模型（LLMs）。这个以阿拉伯语为重点的冻结套件包括三个并行资源中的英语控制，我们在单独的描述性比较中也移除了这些英语控制。杰夫1.14.0在乘以100的标尺上实现了69.24的平均任务主要指标，而杰夫1.13.0为68.77，Gemma-4-31B为71.81，后者是本次综合评估中得分最高的系统。移除记录的英语控制、重复的跨任务项目或两者，都不会改变完整系统的顺序。不同任务族之间，杰夫版本之间的相对性能和增益有所不同。在杰夫1.14.0的内容匹配比较中，四个数据集上的方言减去MSA的准确率差距范围在-7.94到-0.35个百分点之间；方言特定结果显示出更大的变化，SIB-200的源聚类区间包含零。与杰夫1.13.0、Gemma-4-31B和Jais-2-8B的配对对比显示，在同时存在不确定性的情况下，杰夫1.14.0的巴勒斯坦银行惩罚大于任一LLM；其他差距对比仍无定论。这些描述性发现表明，综合得分应与任务族结果、覆盖范围和匹配语言比较一起阅读。它们并未建立方言鲁棒性的一般模型排名，也未解释观察到的差距的原因。

articles.title: Enhancing Mathematical Reasoning in Turkish Large Language Models with Search-Based Inference and Model Merging
articles.abstract: We improve Turkish mathematical reasoning in Large Language Models by combining LoRA fine-tuning, weight-space model merging, and search-based inference. Using Turkish-Llama 8B-DPO with Turkish translations of MetaMath, NuminaMath, and TigerLab, we find data quality beats scale (Mix-30k best among fine-tuned; large MetaMath underperforms). Linear merging delivers the largest gains (GSM8K up to 0.63), while Ties is modest and Breadcrumbs/Slerp degrade. Search with MCTS and Tree of Thoughts improves mean LLM-judge scores for reasoning quality on a 0-100 scale. Limitations include machine translation, limited scale, and search stochasticity.
articles.titleCn: 基于搜索推理和模型融合提升土耳其大型语言模型的数学推理能力
articles.abstractCn: 我们通过结合LoRA微调、权重空间模型合并和基于搜索的推理，提升了大型语言模型在土耳其数学推理方面的能力。使用配备土耳其语翻译的MetaMath、NuminaMath和TigerLab的土耳其语Llama 8B-DPO，我们发现数据质量优于规模（混合30k在微调中表现最佳；大型MetaMath表现不佳）。线性合并带来了最大收益（GSM8K提升至0.63），而Ties效果一般，Breadcrumbs/Slerp则有所下降。使用MCTS和Tree of Thoughts的搜索方法提高了0-100分制下推理质量的平均LLM裁判分数。局限性包括机器翻译、规模有限以及搜索的随机性。

articles.title: Adapting Large Language Models via Multi-Task Learning for Mental Health Problem, Emotion, and Sentiment Detection
articles.abstract: This study investigates sequential multi-task learning using Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), LoRA, and 4-bit quantization on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct for mental health problem detection, emotion detection, and sentiment analysis. Using 4,243 English social media posts, it compares two task sequences and demonstrates that task ordering significantly affects knowledge transfer and task interference. The MHP-first sequence achieves the best mental health problem detection (Micro-F1: 0.7624), while the Emotion-first sequence performs better in emotion (F1: 0.6052) and sentiment analysis (F1: 0.9459). A Joint-MTL baseline further highlights the challenges of simultaneous learning, including task interference and generative format collapse. Overall, the findings demonstrate the effectiveness of sequential PEFT for mental health NLP while showing that task order is critical to balancing performance across related tasks. The integration of LoRA and 4-bit quantization also reduces computational and memory requirements, supporting the adaptation of large language models in resource-constrained environments.
articles.titleCn: 通过多任务学习适应大型语言模型以进行心理健康问题、情绪和情感检测
articles.abstractCn: 本研究探讨了在Llama 3.1 8B Instruct模型上，使用参数高效微调（PEFT）、LoRA和4位量化技术进行顺序多任务学习，应用于心理健康问题检测、情绪检测和情感分析。研究基于4,243篇英文社交媒体帖子，对比了两种任务序列，并证明任务排序显著影响知识迁移和任务干扰。MHP-first序列在心理健康问题检测上表现最佳（Micro-F1: 0.7624），而Emotion-first序列在情绪检测（F1: 0.6052）和情感分析（F1: 0.9459）上表现更优。联合多任务学习基线进一步凸显了同步学习的挑战，包括任务干扰和生成格式崩溃。总体而言，研究结果表明顺序PEFT在心理健康NLP领域的有效性，同时证明任务顺序对平衡相关任务性能至关重要。LoRA和4位量化的集成也降低了计算和内存需求，支持大型语言模型在资源受限环境中的适配。

articles.title: Generating Diverse and Verified Synthetic Clinical Notes with Labels by Construction
articles.abstract: Under strict privacy regulations in the clinical domain, de-identification is necessary to enable the use of clinical data such as for natural language processing. However, we currently lack sophisticated ways to tell which de-identification models actually are suitable. Specifically, we need benchmarks that are challenging, diverse, and clinically plausible, all while ensuring label correctness. To this end, we present SPARCLING, an LLM-based pipeline to generate synthetic discharge letters with character-exact PHI span annotations. Our pipeline combines structured attribute sampling, template generation, and red teaming to obtain diverse PHI-labeled discharge letters. In our experiments, we demonstrate this superior content diversity over existing public datasets. Further, we show SPARCLING's downstream utility as a benchmark to uncover failure modes of de-identifiers in the German clinical domain. Finally, our experiments show that training on our synthetic data can yield more capable de-identifiers than training on the scarce public data alone. Our code is available at https://github.com/Matt00n/phi_discharge_letter_generator.
articles.comment: Accepted at the GenAI for Health Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026. 38 pages including appendix. Code: https://github.com/Matt00n/phi_discharge_letter_generator
articles.titleCn: 通过构建生成多样且经过验证的带标签合成临床记录
articles.abstractCn: 在临床领域严格的隐私法规下，去识别化对于使用临床数据（如自然语言处理）至关重要。然而，我们目前缺乏能够判断哪些去识别化模型真正适用的复杂方法。具体而言，我们需要具有挑战性、多样性和临床合理性的基准，同时确保标签的正确性。为此，我们提出了SPARCLING，一个基于大型语言模型的流程，用于生成具有字符级精确PHI跨度标注的合成出院记录。我们的流程结合了结构化属性采样、模板生成和红队测试，以获得多样化的PHI标注出院记录。在我们的实验中，我们展示了其优于现有公共数据集的内容多样性。此外，我们展示了SPARCLING作为基准在德国临床领域揭示去识别化器失效模式的应用价值。最后，我们的实验表明，在合成数据上进行训练可以生成比仅使用稀缺公共数据进行训练更具能力的去识别化器。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Matt00n/phi_discharge_letter_generator获取。

articles.title: Cascading Circle Loss: Order-Preserving Contrastive Learning for Graded Legal Retrieval
articles.abstract: This paper introduces Cascading Circle Loss (CasCL), a contrastive learning framework for legal retrieval tasks with graded relevance. CasCL combines an InfoNCE objective for positive-negative separation with a cascade of ranking boundaries that model ordered relevance levels between queries and legal clauses. The framework also includes a negative-aware self-paced optimization mechanism and a relevance gain weighting strategy to improve ranking quality. Experiments on legal passage retrieval benchmarks show that CasCL consistently outperforms existing methods, including InfoNCE, Circle Loss, MNRL and Margin MSE, across both binary retrieval and graded ranking metrics.
articles.titleCn: 级联圆损失：用于等级法律检索的顺序保留对比学习
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了一种名为级联圆圈损失（CasCL）的对比学习框架，用于处理具有分级相关性的法律检索任务。CasCL结合了用于正负样本分离的InfoNCE目标以及一系列排名边界，这些边界用于建模查询和法律条款之间的有序相关性级别。该框架还包括一种负样本感知的自适应优化机制和一种相关性增益加权策略，以提高排名质量。在法律段落检索基准测试中，CasCL在二元检索和分级排名指标上均持续优于现有方法，包括InfoNCE、Circle Loss、MNRL和Margin MSE。

articles.title: Evaluating Physically Grounded Procedural Reasoning in VLMs through Real-World Execution: Crochet as a Testbed
articles.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can generate procedures that look convincing on paper, but do they work in practice? In this paper, we propose crochet as an ideal testbed for physically grounded procedural reasoning in VLMs. Crochet cannot be reliably simulated or automated: the only way to know what a pattern produces is to make it by hand, yet verification is tangible and cheap, requiring nothing but a hook and a ball of yarn. We introduce FoundationChain, a deceptively simple test of procedural reasoning: given an image of a basic crochet object, can VLMs infer how it was made and generate a pattern that produces the same result? We crochet 40 patterns generated by four VLMs by hand. Even at this scale, physical execution not only reveals failures that automated proxies cannot detect, but also enables a more precise diagnosis of their causes and consequences: while models write fluent, convincing patterns, only four are free of errors, and our analysis exposes deficiencies in visual, geometric and procedural reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 通过真实世界执行评估VLMs中的物理基础程序推理：钩针作为测试平台
articles.abstractCn: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能够在理论上生成看似可信的流程，但它们在实际中是否有效？在本文中，我们提出钩针编织作为VLMs物理化程序推理的理想测试平台。钩针编织无法可靠地模拟或自动化：要了解一个图样会产出什么，唯一的方法是手工制作，而验证过程既直观又经济，仅需一根钩针和一球毛线。我们引入了FoundationChain，这是一个看似简单的程序推理测试：给定一个基本钩针编织物的图像，VLMs能否推断其制作方法并生成一个能产生相同结果的图样？我们手工钩织了四个VLMs生成的40个图样。即使在这个规模下，物理执行不仅揭示了自动化代理无法检测到的失败，还使它们的原因和后果的诊断更加精确：虽然模型能写出流畅、令人信服的图样，但只有四个没有错误，我们的分析揭示了它们在视觉、几何和程序推理方面的不足。

articles.title: Matchability-Aware Conformal Prediction for Open-Ended Language Model Generation
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often do not produce calibrated uncertainty estimates for their answers. We propose CAELUM, a framework that builds semantic prediction sets while separating aleatoric from epistemic uncertainty. CAELUM samples answers using an ensemble of clarification prompts, clusters them by semantic equivalence, and estimates the aleatoric and epistemic components via kernel-based von Neumann entropy before calibrating nonconformity scores with split conformal prediction. We use a weight $w_λ(x)=1+U_{\mathrm{ale}}(x)+λ\,U_{\mathrm{epi}}(x)$ to control for the contribution of the epistemic uncertainty of each instance and fit a coefficient $λ^\star$ to minimize prediction set size. When the objective is nonflat and selection is stable across splits, $λ^\star$ could be a diagnostic, where large values may indicate epistemic dominance (retrieve, abstain) and $λ^\star\to 0$ aleatoric dominance (clarify). For individual queries, a log ratio $R(x)$ compares the weighted epistemic component with the aleatoric component. Theoretically, we demonstrate that the coverage is capped by matchability, the fraction of items whose reference answer appears in any sampled cluster. Empirically, this matchability can be predicted from the original question features using a lightweight classifier. We use those predictions to define a stratum and derive a conformal coverage bound within it. Across 30 LLM and dataset combinations (4-32B), mean coverage is 0.74 in the learned stratum versus 0.65 overall, averaged over the 78 evaluations using the learned classifier. Project page: https://unco3892.github.io/caelum/

articles.titleCn: 面向开放式语言模型生成的可匹配性感知一致性预测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常无法为其答案提供校准的不确定性估计。我们提出了CAELUM框架，该框架在分离偶然不确定性和认知不确定性时构建语义预测集。CAELUM使用澄清提示的集成来采样答案，通过语义等价性对它们进行聚类，并通过基于核的冯·诺依曼熵估计偶然不确定性和认知成分，然后使用分割一致性预测校准非一致性分数。我们使用权重$w_λ(x)=1+U_{\mathrm{ale}}(x)+λ\,U_{\mathrm{epi}}(x)$来控制每个实例的认知不确定性的贡献，并拟合系数$λ^\star$以最小化预测集的大小。当目标非平坦且选择在分割中稳定时，$λ^\star$可以是一个诊断指标，其中大值可能表示认知主导（检索、拒绝），而$λ^\star\to 0$表示偶然主导（澄清）。对于单个查询，对数比$R(x)$比较了加权认知成分和偶然成分。理论上，我们证明了覆盖范围受匹配性限制，匹配性是指参考答案出现在任何采样聚类中的项目比例。经验上，这种匹配性可以使用轻量级分类器从原始问题特征中预测。我们使用这些预测来定义一个层，并在其中推导出一致性覆盖范围界限。在30种LLM和数据集组合（4-32B）中，学习到的层的平均覆盖率为0.74，而整体平均覆盖率为0.65，这是在78次评估中使用学习到的分类器得出的。项目页面：https://unco3892.github.io/caelum/

articles.title: Behavioral Evaluation of Large Language Models Under Cognitive Biases in HAZOP Studies
articles.abstract: Hazard and Operability (HAZOP) studies safeguard industrial processes against catastrophic accidents. Large language models (LLMs) increasingly assist HAZOP drafting, yet evaluations rely on lexical overlap. Because LLMs internalize human heuristics, prompts may trigger biased judgments. Whether frontier LLMs withstand cognitive perturbations in safety-critical workflows remains unknown. Here we show across 420 trials that three frontier LLMs resisted 96.8% of cognitive manipulations, rendering overall susceptibility statistically inconclusive. Contrary to assumed broad fragility, models rejected confirmation and availability cues. However, safety-critical risk downgrades emerged under low anchors and gain frames. Thus, automated hazard analysis requires disciplined human-in-the-loop validation.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Submitted to IFAC for possible publication. Supplementary material available at https://github.com/ViniMelloeMuller/psyhazop-supplementary-material
articles.titleCn: 在HAZOP研究中认知偏差下大型语言模型的行为评估
articles.abstractCn: 危险与可操作性分析（HAZOP）研究旨在保护工业流程免受灾难性事故的侵害。大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地协助HAZOP的起草工作，但评估依赖于词汇重叠。由于LLM内化了人类的启发式方法，提示可能会引发有偏见的判断。前沿LLM在安全关键工作流程中是否能够抵御认知干扰尚不清楚。在这里，通过对420次试验的分析，我们表明三种前沿LLM抵抗了96.8%的认知操纵，使得整体易感性在统计学上没有明确结论。与假设的普遍脆弱性相反，模型拒绝了确认和可用性线索。然而，在低锚定和收益框架下，出现了安全关键风险降级。因此，自动化危险分析需要严格的人机交互验证。

articles.title: Perception, Not Reasoning, Limits Visual Theory of Mind
articles.abstract: Vision-language models pass text-based false-belief probes at near-human levels but drop by over twenty percentage points on abstract panels the moment the same problem is conveyed visually. The consensus diagnosis is conceptual, prescribing new belief-reasoning modules. We argue the dominant bottleneck is perceptual: not what the model cannot reason about, but what it cannot see. We propose a five-condition dissociation protocol that holds the reasoning task constant while varying perceptual fidelity from visual only to text only, and quantify the result with the Perceptual Contribution Ratio, the share of the visual-to-text gap a given fidelity closes. We test this on two kinds of scenes: abstract 2D panels in the Heider--Simmel tradition, and naturalistic 3D game scenes from MuMA-ToM and MindPower. The evaluation covers seven VLMs and roughly 159,000 API calls. Ground-truth scaffolds substantially close the gap in every setting, and on the abstract panels and MuMA-ToM they match or exceed the text-only reasoning. Whereas scaffolds built by automatic parsers, including frontier VLMs, fail. The most common error in the visual-only condition is \emph{reality bias}, which accounts for 60\% of false-belief failures. Models report where an object actually is, not where an absent agent believes it is. This points to a perceptual front-end that fails to track which agents were present at each moment. Under the evaluated protocol, structured visual scene-state extraction, rather than belief inference, is the dominant bottleneck for visual ToM.

articles.titleCn: 感知，而非推理，限制了视觉心智理论
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型在基于文本的虚假信念测试中表现接近人类水平，但在视觉呈现的抽象面板上，当同一问题以视觉形式传达时，其表现会下降超过二十个百分点。普遍的诊断是概念层面的，建议引入新的信念推理模块。我们认为主要的瓶颈在于感知层面：不是模型无法推理的内容，而是它无法看见的内容。我们提出了一种五条件分离协议，在保持推理任务不变的情况下，从纯视觉到纯文本逐步改变感知保真度，并使用感知贡献率（即特定保真度缩小视觉到文本差距的比例）量化结果。我们在两种场景中进行了测试：海德-辛姆勒传统的抽象二维面板，以及来自MuMA-ToM和MindPower的自然主义三维游戏场景。评估涵盖了七种视觉语言模型和约159,000次API调用。在所有设置中，真实情况框架都显著缩小了差距，在抽象面板和MuMA-ToM测试中，其表现甚至超越了纯文本推理。而由自动解析器构建的框架，包括前沿视觉语言模型，则完全失败。在纯视觉条件下最常见的错误是“现实偏差”，占虚假信念失败的60%。模型报告的是物体实际所在位置，而不是缺席代理所相信的位置。这表明感知前端未能追踪每个时刻哪些代理存在。在评估协议下，结构化视觉场景状态提取，而非信念推理，是视觉心智理论的主要瓶颈。

articles.title: Machine Hearing: Can Audio LLMs Generalize Beyond Human Auditory Perception?
articles.abstract: Multimodal LLMs have made remarkable progress in perceiving the physical world, while their perceptual scope remains largely human-centric, focusing on what humans can directly see or hear. This progress raises the prospect of perception beyond human limits, such as extending hearing to sounds that are inaudible to humans. More broadly, the physical world is full of waves, vibrations, and oscillations, only a small fraction of which are directly audible to humans. This invites the extension of multimodal LLMs toward a broader form of machine hearing, which remains largely underexplored. To investigate this direction, we introduce the Machine Hearing Benchmark (MHB), comprising 6,128 instances across 13 tasks and seven domains. MHB spans highly heterogeneous input regimes, with sampling rates from approximately $10^{-5}$ to $10^6$ Hz, sequence lengths from $10^1$ to $10^6$ samples, and both single- and multi-channel inputs. Evaluations of current open-source and proprietary Audio LLMs (ALLMs) reveal limited zero-shot transfer to machine hearing. Supervised adaptation on machine-hearing data alone does not close this gap, suggesting that the challenge extends beyond data exposure to a systematic mismatch between existing audio front ends and machine-hearing inputs. To address this mismatch, we introduce MachEar, a lightweight encoder extension that complements the pretrained Audio LLM for machine-hearing inputs. The results show that MachEar equips a pretrained Audio LLM with stronger machine-hearing capabilities while largely preserving its existing audio understanding performance.
articles.titleCn: 机器听觉：音频大型语言模型能否超越人类听觉感知进行泛化？
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型在感知物理世界方面取得了显著进展，但其感知范围仍主要局限于人类中心，关注人类可以直接看到或听到的信息。这一进展为超越人类感知极限提供了可能，例如将听觉扩展到人类听不到的声音。更广泛地说，物理世界充满了各种波、振动和振荡，其中只有一小部分可以直接被人类听到。这促使多模态大型语言模型向更广泛的机器听觉形式发展，而这一方向仍基本处于探索阶段。为了研究这一方向，我们引入了机器听觉基准（MHB），包含13项任务和七个领域的6,128个实例。MHB涵盖了高度异构的输入模式，采样率从约$10^{-5}$到$10^6$ Hz，序列长度从$10^1$到$10^6$个样本，以及单通道和多通道输入。对当前开源和专有的音频大型语言模型（ALLMs）的评估显示，它们在机器听觉方面的零样本迁移能力有限。仅通过机器听觉数据进行监督适应并不能缩小这一差距，这表明挑战不仅在于数据接触，还在于现有音频前端与机器听觉输入之间存在的系统性不匹配。为解决这一不匹配问题，我们引入了MachEar，这是一种轻量级的编码器扩展，用于增强预训练音频大型语言模型处理机器听觉输入的能力。结果表明，MachEar在增强预训练音频大型语言模型机器听觉能力的同时，基本保留了其现有的音频理解性能。

articles.title: TransMem: Transition-Aware Retrieval for Evolving Personal Memory
articles.abstract: Long-term personalized agents are increasingly expected to answer queries over user histories in which preferences, goals, and constraints evolve across interleaved conversations. Existing retrieval-based and structured-memory systems can surface relevant facts, but often return isolated memory units that do not explain which earlier preference was refined, contradicted, or superseded by later evidence. We introduce TransMem, a transition-aware memory retrieval framework that stores preference updates as explicit retrieval units alongside ordinary factual memories. During memory construction, TransMem routes user interaction history into topic-structured memory graphs, detects shift events, and grounds them as transition records. At inference time, TransMem first retrieves factual anchors and then adaptively expands over transition records, producing a compact context of factual anchors and accepted transition records. Experiments on PersonaMem and PersonaBench across two Qwen backbones show that TransMem outperforms representative retrieval-based and structured-memory baselines. Controlled analyses further show that transition records and adaptive expansion contribute beyond factual anchoring, chronological expansion, flat transition retrieval, and fixed-hop traversal. These results suggest that preference-update records are useful retrieval units for long-term personalization.
articles.titleCn: TransMem：适应变化的个人记忆的过渡感知检索
articles.abstractCn: 长期个性化代理被越来越广泛地期望能够根据用户历史记录进行查询，其中用户的偏好、目标和约束在交错对话中不断演变。现有的基于检索和结构化记忆系统可以呈现相关事实，但通常返回孤立的记忆单元，无法解释哪些早期的偏好被后来的证据所完善、反驳或取代。我们介绍了TransMem，这是一个具有转换感知的记忆检索框架，它将偏好更新作为明确的检索单元与普通的事实记忆一起存储。在记忆构建过程中，TransMem将用户交互历史路由到主题结构化的记忆图中，检测转换事件，并将其作为转换记录进行锚定。在推理时，TransMem首先检索事实锚点，然后自适应地扩展转换记录，生成一个包含事实锚点和被接受的转换记录的紧凑上下文。在PersonaMem和PersonaBench上的实验表明，在两个Qwen主干上，TransMem优于具有代表性的基于检索和结构化记忆的基线模型。受控分析进一步表明，转换记录和自适应扩展在事实锚定、时间顺序扩展、平面转换检索和固定跳转遍历方面都做出了贡献。这些结果表明，偏好更新记录是长期个性化中有效的检索单元。

articles.title: Pandemonium: Longform Target-Speaker Speech Recognition with Cross-Speaker Interactions
articles.abstract: Diarization-conditioned target-speaker ASR (TS-ASR), in particular Diarization-conditioned Whisper (DiCoW), is an accurate and data-efficient approach to multi-talker transcription. It has, however, three structural limitations: the model transcribes each speaker independently, operates on short (30 s) windows, and optimizes its diarization and TS-ASR components separately. We address the first two. We integrate the diarization conditioning into a longform Parakeet backbone (DiCoP) and add cross-speaker attention, which lets the model attend across the speaker dimension so that speakers are no longer decoded in isolation, and an STNO mask refiner that re-estimates the diarization-derived conditioning. As conversational data with genuine multi-speaker interaction is scarce, we scale training with a pseudo-labeling pipeline that mines 5.4k hours of in-the-wild multi-speaker audio from YODAS2. Combining these with synthetic and real data yields state-of-the-art results across several meeting benchmarks. We open-source the resulting models, DiCoP and Pandemonium, and the pseudo-labeled data.
articles.titleCn: 混沌：长文本目标说话人语音识别与跨说话人交互
articles.abstractCn: 基于说话人分割条件的目标说话人语音识别（TS-ASR），特别是基于说话人分割条件的Whisper（DiCoW），是一种准确且数据高效的多说话人转录方法。然而，它存在三个结构性限制：模型独立地对每个说话人进行转录、在短（30秒）窗口上运行，以及分别优化说话人分割和TS-ASR组件。我们解决了前两个问题。我们将说话人分割条件整合到长序列Parakeet主干（DiCoP）中，并添加跨说话人注意力机制，使模型能够在说话人维度上进行注意力分配，从而不再独立解码说话人，并增加了一个STNO掩码细化器，用于重新估计基于说话人分割的分割条件。由于具有真实多说话人交互的对话数据稀缺，我们通过伪标签流程扩展训练，该流程从YODAS2中挖掘了5.4千小时的野外多说话人音频。结合这些与合成和真实数据，我们在多个会议基准上取得了最先进的结果。我们开源了由此产生的模型DiCoP和Pandemonium，以及伪标签数据。

articles.title: On the Geometric Bottlenecks of Cross-Lingual Knowledge Editing
articles.abstract: Transformer-based autoregressive multilingual language models (LMs) are often assumed to store factual knowledge in an interlingua: a language-agnostic latent space. If this assumption holds, a parameter update applied in a source language during knowledge editing should inherently propagate to its semantic equivalents in target languages. However, empirical benchmarks show that cross-lingual propagation of edits often degrades substantially, a degradation that prior work treats largely as an algorithmic symptom rather than a structural bottleneck. In this work, we investigate whether representational anisotropy creates a structural bottleneck for source-only associative-memory editing, and perform a geometric dissection of the cross-lingual propagation gap. Using associative memory-based "locate-then-edit" methods, including ROME, MEMIT, and AlphaEdit, as analytical frameworks, we derive a closed-form decomposition of this gap into key-space propagation, parallel residual mismatch, and orthogonal residual mismatch. Our empirical findings show that cross-lingual propagation is primarily bottlenecked by a large orthogonal residual component, indicating that source-language edits often fail to span the target-language update directions required for successful transfer. Furthermore, we show that post-hoc correction using only source-language residual statistics encounters a large residual-prediction barrier. Finally, we perform a structural realignment via a targeted contrastive alignment objective and find that it substantially improves key-space propagation and partially improves cross-lingual edit transfer, while leaving value-space mismatch as a remaining bottleneck.
articles.titleCn: 跨语言知识编辑的几何瓶颈
articles.abstractCn: 基于Transformer的自回归多语言语言模型（LMs）通常被认为在一种语言无关的潜在空间（即互语言）中存储事实性知识。如果这一假设成立，那么在知识编辑过程中对源语言进行的参数更新应该会自然地传播到目标语言的语义等价物上。然而，实证基准表明，跨语言的编辑传播往往会显著退化，而先前的工作通常将这种退化视为算法症状而非结构性瓶颈。在本工作中，我们研究了表征各向异性是否为仅源语言的关联记忆编辑创造了结构性瓶颈，并对跨语言传播的差距进行了几何剖析。我们使用基于关联记忆的“定位后编辑”方法，包括ROME、MEMIT和AlphaEdit，作为分析框架，将这一差距分解为关键空间传播、并行残差失配和正交残差失配的封闭形式分解。我们的实证发现表明，跨语言传播主要受到较大的正交残差分量的瓶颈，表明源语言的编辑往往无法覆盖成功迁移所需的目标语言更新方向。此外，我们还表明，仅使用源语言残差统计信息进行后处理校正会遇到较大的残差预测壁垒。最后，我们通过一个有针对性的对比对齐目标进行结构重配，发现这显著改善了关键空间传播，并部分改善了跨语言编辑迁移，但留下了值空间失配作为剩余的瓶颈。

articles.title: Same Contacts, Different Rooms:Meeting Format Shapes LLM Group Influence Beyond Pairwise Contact Counts
articles.abstract: Simulations of LLM agent collectives usually summarise interaction as a pairwise contact network. We test that summary with a contact-matched intervention: the members, their initial stances and every pairwise contact count stay fixed while the meetings are reorganised, and each member gives a one-step support readout after reading the arguments of everyone present. Across six open-weight LLMs and 14 debate topics, merging triads into five-person meetings (resize) moves group support more than reshuffling who meets in triads (regroup), although both move the same 60 dyadic exposures. The root-mean-square change is 4.36 versus 2.59 percentage points (pp), larger for resize in all six models and in 81 of 84 model-topic cells. Resizing also has a consistent direction: it amplifies the initial majority of the merged members by 1.72 pp, in every model, whereas regrouping has no direction (<= 0.03 pp). A contact network cannot represent regrouping at all, yet pairwise rules applied meeting by meeting explain up to 76% of its effect, and with identical weights they raise resize R^2 by 0.51-0.58 for two models. We show that the gap between the two placements is an exact Jensen gap of the sigmoid readout, bounded by how much a member's predicted logits vary across meetings; this dispersion tracks the gap with log-log r=0.97 and tells a modeller when contact counts are a safe summary. Meeting format is a first-class variable for LLM social simulation.
articles.titleCn: 相同联系人，不同房间：会议形式超越成对联系人数量，塑造大型语言模型群体影响
articles.abstractCn: 对大型语言模型（LLM）代理群体的模拟通常将互动总结为成对接触网络。我们通过接触匹配干预来检验这一总结：成员、其初始立场以及每对接触次数保持固定，而会议重新组织，每位成员在阅读所有在场者的论点后进行一步支持读数。在六个开放权重LLM和14个辩论主题中，将三元组合并为五人会议（resize）比重新组织三元组中的会面（regroup）更能推动群体支持，尽管两者都产生了相同数量的60对二元暴露。均方根变化为4.36与2.59个百分点（pp），在所有六个模型和84个模型主题单元中的81个中，resize的影响更大。resize还具有一致的方向：它在每个模型中通过增加合并成员的初始多数1.72个百分点来放大群体支持，而regroup则没有方向（<= 0.03个百分点）。接触网络完全无法表示regrouping，但逐次会议应用的成对规则解释了其高达76%的影响，并且使用相同的权重，这两个模型中的resize R^2提高了0.51-0.58。我们证明，这两种安排之间的差距是Sigmoid读数的精确Jensen差距，其范围受成员在不同会议中预测的logits变化程度限制；这种分散度与对数-对数r=0.97的差距同步，并告诉建模者何时接触次数是一个安全的总结。会议形式是LLM社会模拟的一流变量。

articles.title: Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention: Closed-Loop Quality Control for Long-Context LLM Decoding
articles.abstract: Sparse attention accelerates long-context decoding by reading a subset of the KV cache, but existing methods are open-loop: the kernel commits to its selection with no signal indicating whether enough attention mass was preserved and no recovery path when it was not. The needed signal already exists inside the kernel. The fraction of softmax mass on the selected tokens, which we call coverage, satisfies an exact algebraic equality with per-step output error and serves a dual role as the acceptance criterion and the interpolation weight for recovery. Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention (CVSA) turns coverage into a training-free, closed-loop verify-then-correct decode loop that accepts high-coverage drafts and recovers only the heads that fall short, with no sampling, no draft model, and no speculative-decoding infrastructure. Quality varies by only $0.14$ points across the threshold sweep; budget and scheduling ablations characterize the deployed operating point. On LongBench at 7B and 70B, CVSA comes within $1.13$ points of dense attention, statistically matching it at 70B, and it loses $0.8$ points on RULER; measured median decode-step speedup reaches $6.21\times$ at 128K context.

articles.titleCn: 覆盖验证稀疏注意力：长上下文LLM解码的闭环质量控制
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏注意力通过读取KV缓存的子集来加速长上下文解码，但现有方法都是开环的：内核对其选择做出承诺，没有任何信号表明是否保留了足够的注意力质量，也没有恢复路径。所需的信号已经存在于内核中。在选定标记上的softmax质量分数，我们称之为覆盖率，与每步输出误差满足精确的代数等式，并充当接受标准和恢复插值权重的双重角色。覆盖率验证稀疏注意力（CVSA）将覆盖率转化为无需训练的闭环验证后校正解码循环，接受高覆盖率草稿，仅恢复不足的部分，无需采样，无需草稿模型，也无需推测解码基础设施。在阈值扫描中，质量差异仅为0.14分；预算和调度消融特征化了部署的操作点。在LongBench上，7B和70B时，CVSA与密集注意力相差1.13分，在70B时统计上与之相当，并在RULER上损失0.8分；测量的中位数解码步速度提升在128K上下文中达到6.21倍。

articles.title: What Do Collusion Probes Read? Three Pitfalls in Evaluating Multi-Agent Collusion Monitors
articles.abstract: Activation probes look like near-perfect monitors for secret collusion among large language model (LLM) agents. We show that they mostly detect that an agent was told to collude, not that it decided to. Our benchmark (2,500 committee and 1,476 code-review episodes) adds agents who receive the collusion instruction and refuse it, separating instruction from decision. Published detectors barely tell colluders from these refusers, and our best probe separates them mostly by reading the instruction: without it, agent AUROC falls from 1.00 to 0.61. Two further pitfalls inflate reported results: scored after the vote, a rule that only reads the votes reaches AUROC 0.990 but finds nothing before it; and in 57% of attempts no colluder argues for the target in public. The decision is still there: a probe trained on agents' own choices reads it (AUROC 0.73 without the instruction), and probes find colluders whose goal was fine-tuned into the weights (AUROC 0.995; pre-registered). We turn the controls into a protocol for testing any collusion monitor, and adapt scan statistics into an online monitor for groups of any size.

articles.titleCn: 调查合谋行为读取了什么？评估多智能体合谋监控器的三个陷阱
articles.abstractCn: 激活探针看似是监控大型语言模型（LLM）代理间秘密勾结的完美工具。我们证明它们主要检测的是代理被指示勾结，而非其主动决定。我们的基准测试（包含2500个委员会场景和1476个代码评审场景）引入了接收勾结指令但拒绝执行的代理，从而区分了指令与决策。现有检测器几乎无法区分勾结者与这些拒绝者，而我们最佳探针主要通过读取指令将两者分离：没有指令时，代理AUROC从1.00降至0.61。另外两个陷阱夸大了报告结果：投票后评分的规则仅读取投票即可达到AUROC 0.990，但在投票前却一无所获；57%的尝试中勾结者未在公开场合为目标辩护。决策依然存在：基于代理自身选择的训练探针能读取它（无指令时AUROC为0.73），探针还能检测到目标被微调进权重（AUROC为0.995；已预注册）。我们将控制措施转化为测试任何勾结监控器的协议，并将扫描统计方法调整为适用于任何规模群体的在线监控器。

articles.title: AI in the Clinical Documentation Loop: Effects of LLM-Induced Note Bloat and Diagnostic Overcall on Downstream LLMs
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to process medical records for healthcare tasks such as clinical documentation. Because these tools also generate documentation, the relationship is now bidirectional: models both read from and write to the record. Understanding how LLMs behave when reading records that already contain LLM-authored content is therefore critical for their safe deployment. In this study, we examine how LLM-authored content in the medical record affects downstream LLMs that read the same record. We consider two types of LLM-induced artifacts: bloat, in which LLM-generated summaries accumulate in the record and change the length and provenance of its content over time; and distortion, in which LLMs subtly alter clinical findings rather than fabricating facts outright. As a case of distortion, we study diagnostic overcall (documenting an unconfirmed differential diagnosis in the record) and test whether it propagates to the reader LLM's output. Across seven reader models from four families, we find evidence of both effects. First, LLM-generated summary notes modestly but consistently degraded downstream hospital-course generation compared with copy-forward and templated text of matched length. Second, injected overcalls reappeared in downstream outputs at rates that varied by reader model, without detectable changes in standard quality metrics. These findings show the need to monitor AI-generated content in medical records and to account for it when those records are later processed by AI.
articles.titleCn: AI在临床文档循环中的作用：LLM引起的记录冗余和诊断过度调用对下游LLM的影响
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于处理医疗记录，以支持临床文档等医疗任务。由于这些工具也能生成文档，因此现在这种关系是双向的：模型既从记录中读取信息，也向记录中写入信息。因此，理解LLM在读取已包含LLM生成内容的记录时的行为，对于其安全部署至关重要。在本研究中，我们考察了医疗记录中LLM生成内容如何影响后续读取同一记录的LLM。我们考虑了两种LLM诱导的伪影类型：一是冗余，即LLM生成的摘要随着时间的推移在记录中累积，改变了记录内容的长度和来源；二是扭曲，即LLM微妙地改变临床发现，而非直接编造事实。作为扭曲的一种案例，我们研究了诊断过度呼叫（在记录中记录未经确认的鉴别诊断），并测试了它是否传播到阅读LLM的输出。在四个家族的七种阅读模型中，我们发现这两种效应均有证据。首先，与长度相匹配的复制转发和模板文本相比，LLM生成的摘要笔记略微但一致地降低了下游医院病程生成的质量。其次，注入的过度呼叫以不同的速率重新出现在下游输出中，而标准质量指标未出现可检测的变化。这些发现表明，在AI生成的医疗记录内容需要被监控，并在这些记录被AI后续处理时加以考虑。

articles.title: Global Context Guidance for Diffusion Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs, enabling parallel generation through iterative denoising. Recent guidance methods improve diffusion LLMs by introducing a weak model to guide the prediction of the base model during denoising. However, the influence of the weak model during denoising remains less clear, and computing its prediction requires an additional forward pass at each denoising step. We present in this paper an in-depth analysis of how diffusion LLMs use contextual information during denoising. Our analysis reveals that diffusion LLMs rely more heavily on local context while often underutilizing global context. Based on this observation, we introduce Global Context Guidance (GCG), a feature-space guidance method that enhances global-context utilization without constructing an explicit weak model. Extensive experiments on LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B, and LLaDA-1.5 across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that GCG consistently outperforms existing guidance methods, while incurring much lower inference overhead.
articles.titleCn: 扩散大型语言模型的全球背景指南
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型（LLMs）最近已成为自回归LLMs的一种有前景的替代方案，通过迭代去噪实现并行生成。最近的指导方法通过引入一个弱模型来指导基础模型在去噪过程中的预测，从而改进扩散LLMs。然而，弱模型在去噪过程中的影响尚不明确，并且计算其预测需要在每个去噪步骤中增加一次前向传递。本文深入分析了扩散LLMs在去噪过程中如何使用上下文信息。我们的分析表明，扩散LLMs更依赖局部上下文，而往往未能充分利用全局上下文。基于这一观察，我们引入了全局上下文指导（GCG），这是一种特征空间指导方法，能够在不构建显式弱模型的情况下增强全局上下文的利用。在LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B和LLaDA-1.5等多个基准测试上的大量实验表明，GCG始终优于现有的指导方法，同时推理开销却低得多。

articles.title: Large Language Models without QK-Normalization
articles.abstract: Query-Key Normalization (QK-Norm) is widely adopted in modern large language models to control the growth of attention logits and improve training stability. However, query and key norms are not merely sources of instability. The query norm controls the sharpness of the attention distribution, while the key norm determines how strongly a token attracts different queries. These norms therefore carry token-specific information about attention selectivity and token importance. By normalizing both, QK-Norm suppresses this information. This raises a natural question: can we control query-key representations without discarding their sensitivity to magnitude? To address this question, we propose QK-MAP, a Magnitude-Aware Projection for constructing queries and keys. Rather than removing magnitude through normalization, QK-MAP transforms the input representation using multiple learnable frequencies, so that changes in magnitude are encoded as bounded phase patterns. This allows magnitude to be represented through phase and direction rather than vector length alone. Its periodic features have a fixed norm while remaining sensitive to magnitude changes, separating magnitude encoding from norm growth. Multiple frequencies further help distinguish magnitudes and reduce periodic ambiguity. Experiments across model scales from 190M to 7B parameters show that QK-MAP achieves lower training and validation loss than both Standard attention and QK-Norm. Further analyses show that QK-MAP preserves sensitivity to input scale, assigns less attention to the first token, and produces stronger attention contrast for relevant evidence in synthetic long-context tests. These results demonstrate that query-key scale can be effectively controlled without sacrificing token-specific magnitude information.
articles.titleCn: 没有QK-Normalization的大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 查询键归一化（QK-Norm）在现代大型语言模型中被广泛采用，用于控制注意力logits的增长并提高训练稳定性。然而，查询和键归一化并不仅仅是导致不稳定性的来源。查询归一化控制了注意力分布的尖锐程度，而键归一化决定了单个token吸引不同查询的强度。因此，这些归一化包含了关于注意力选择性和token重要性的特定token信息。通过同时归一化这两个值，QK-Norm抑制了这些信息。这就引出了一个自然的问题：我们能否在不丢弃其幅度敏感性的情况下控制查询键表示？为了回答这个问题，我们提出了QK-MAP，一种感知幅度的投影方法，用于构建查询和键。QK-MAP不是通过归一化来移除幅度，而是使用多个可学习的频率来转换输入表示，使得幅度变化被编码为有界的相位模式。这使得幅度可以通过相位和方向来表示，而不仅仅是向量长度。其周期性特征具有固定的范数，同时仍然对幅度变化敏感，从而将幅度编码与范数增长分离开来。多个频率进一步有助于区分幅度并减少周期性歧义。跨越从1.9亿到70亿参数规模的模型实验表明，QK-MAP比标准注意力和QK-Norm都实现了更低的训练和验证损失。进一步分析表明，QK-MAP保留了输入尺度的敏感性，对第一个token分配的注意力较少，并在合成长上下文测试中为相关证据产生了更强的注意力对比。这些结果表明，在不牺牲特定token幅度信息的情况下，可以有效地控制查询键的尺度。

articles.title: onóna: Twin Embeddings with Tied Unembeddings
articles.abstract: Weight tying reduces the parameter cost of language models, but the usual tied output head is limited to a single softmax. We introduce onóna, a two-table parameterization that increases output expressiveness while preserving input-output weight sharing. The Transformer takes the average of two embedding tables as input, and the output head combines the softmax distributions defined by those same tables. A gate conditioned only on the current input token determines the mixture weight. Its values can be precomputed for inference, and the Transformer body remains unchanged. We evaluate onóna across Dense, Gated DeltaNet hybrid, mixture-of-experts, and Attention Residual architectures at 142M, 330M, and 1B scales. Under matched token budgets, onóna lowers final validation loss and external perplexity in 11 of 12 comparisons and raises the average accuracy over eight downstream tasks in 10 of 12. The one exception on loss is the 1B MoE model. The cost is one extra embedding table and one extra vocabulary projection.
articles.titleCn: onóna：绑定解嵌入的双嵌入
articles.abstractCn: 权重绑定降低了语言模型的参数成本，但通常绑定的输出头仅限于单个softmax。我们引入了onóna，一种双表参数化方法，在保持输入输出权重共享的同时提高了输出表达能力。Transformer将两个嵌入表的平均值作为输入，输出头结合由这些相同表定义的softmax分布。一个仅基于当前输入标记的门控决定了混合权重。其值可以预先计算用于推理，Transformer主体保持不变。我们在142M、330M和1B规模的Dense、Gated DeltaNet混合、专家混合和Attention Residual架构上评估了onóna。在匹配的标记预算下，onóna在12次比较中的11次降低了最终验证损失和外部困惑度，并在12次中的10次提高了八个下游任务的平均准确率。损失方面的唯一例外是1B MoE模型。成本是一个额外的嵌入表和一个额外的词汇投影。

articles.title: YRC-Bench: Benchmarking Culturally Aware Machine Translation for Historical Heritage via Tri-Level Semantic Bridging
articles.abstract: Translating historical cultural heritage poses profound challenges for machine translation systems due to the acute semantic asymmetry across eras and cultures, where terse classical syntax frequently obscures domain-specific cultural knowledge. While Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable prowess in generic translation benchmarks, they struggle to negotiate Culturally-Specific Items and diachronic shifts in domain-rich historical texts, such as Yellow River cultural records. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce YRC-Bench, the first human-curated, multi-parallel benchmark dedicated to historical heritage translation across Classical Chinese, Modern Chinese, and nine target foreign languages. YRC-Bench establishes a tri-level parallel corpus incorporating modern explanatory glosses as explicit semantic bridges and operationalizes translation strategies through paired conserved versus substituted CSI variants categorized by cultural translatability. Systematic evaluations of nine leading LLMs across bidirectional translation directions reveal that leveraging modern Chinese glosses - especially human-curated ones - dramatically elevates both lexical fidelity and semantic adequacy. Furthermore, multidimensional human preference audits by native experts unveil distinct cross-cultural preferences between Sinographic-tradition and non-Sinographic language groups.
articles.titleCn: YRC-Bench：通过三级语义桥接对文化遗产文化感知机器翻译进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 将历史文化遗产进行翻译对机器翻译系统构成了严峻挑战，因为不同时代和文化之间存在尖锐的语义不对称性，其中简洁的古典句式常常掩盖特定领域的文化知识。尽管大型语言模型在通用翻译基准测试中展现出卓越能力，但它们难以处理富含文化特定项目（CSI）和历时性变化的领域丰富的历史文本，例如黄河文化记录。为填补这一关键差距，我们引入YRC-Bench，这是首个由人工策划的多平行基准，专门用于古典中文、现代中文和九种目标外语之间的历史遗产翻译。YRC-Bench建立了一个三级平行语料库，将现代解释性注释作为明确的语义桥梁，并通过配对的保留与替换的CSI变体（按文化可翻译性分类）来操作化翻译策略。对九种领先的大型语言模型进行双向翻译方向的系统评估表明，利用现代中文注释——尤其是人工策划的注释——可显著提升词汇准确性和语义充分性。此外，由母语专家进行的多维度偏好审计揭示了书写文化传统与非书写文化群体之间的跨文化偏好差异。

articles.title: AFVE-Bench: Measuring Abandoned-Frame Verbalization Errors in Multi-Turn LLM Revision
articles.abstract: Multi-turn revision often asks a model to replace an earlier organizing frame while preserving still-valid facts and artifact requirements. Existing instruction-following evaluations mainly assess the latest target and may therefore score an artifact as successful even when it adopts the new frame but exposes the superseded one. We call this failure an abandoned-frame verbalization error (AFVE). AFVE-Bench evaluates silent frame replacement in English and Chinese using 192 matched four-turn dialogues across eight writing domains. Each seed has zero, one, or two pre-target user requests to generate under the source frame. AFVE eligibility depends on the user-request history and applies to the one- and two-request conditions; the zero-request condition serves as a frame-bearing baseline. Eleven model configurations yielded 4,224 expected post-target response units. Two annotators independently scored 4,204 scorable responses for target adoption, source-frame verbalization, and direct usability; model and condition metadata were hidden, and disagreements were adjudicated. AFVE occurs in 25.54% (715/2,799) of history-conditioned responses. Of 2,388 target-passing history-conditioned responses, 472 (19.77%) still expose the abandoned source frame, most often through contrastive framing (423/472). For these standalone revision tasks, target adoption does not ensure source-frame silence.
articles.titleCn: AFVE-Bench：测量多轮LLM修订中的废弃帧语言错误
articles.abstractCn: 多轮修订通常要求模型替换早期的组织框架，同时保留仍然有效的信息和工件要求。现有的指令遵循评估主要评估最新目标，因此即使工件采用了新框架但暴露了被取代的框架，也可能将其评为成功。我们将这种错误称为被放弃框架的言语错误（AFVE）。AFVE-Bench 使用192个跨八个写作领域的匹配四轮对话，评估英语和中文中的静默框架替换。每个种子在源框架下生成零个、一个或两个预目标用户请求。AFVE的资格取决于用户请求历史，适用于一个请求和两个请求的条件；零请求条件作为带框架的基线。11个模型配置产生了4,224个预期的目标后响应单元。两个标注员独立对4,204个可评分响应进行目标采用、源框架言语化和直接可用性评分；模型和条件元数据被隐藏，分歧由仲裁解决。AFVE发生在25.54%（715/2,799）的历史条件响应中。在2,388个通过目标的历史条件响应中，472个（19.77%）仍然暴露被放弃的源框架，最常见的是通过对比框架（423/472）。对于这些独立的修订任务，目标采用并不能保证源框架的沉默。

articles.title: In Search of Lost Time: Temporal Competence in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Today's large language models (LLMs) increasingly interact with time: AI agents schedule tasks, coordinate with people and other AI systems, and even decide how long to think. Yet LLMs only ever encounter time secondhand---in descriptions rather than experience. Does this hinder their reasoning and decisions that involve time? Our paper traces this question from a model's knowledge to its actions through four successive evaluations. We find that models know the rules of time, which can be read, but struggle to predict durations, which must be lived; while they are highly accurate (92.0-97.5\%) on a collection of questions built from the theorems of various time-related literatures, they underestimate their own completion times by up to 99.5\% and fail to identify which tasks will take them longer to run. And while they are better at estimating durations of human tasks, their duration judgments change based on how an event is worded, magnifying similar human biases by up to 1.3$\times$. Moving from estimation to action, we find that some LLMs disregard time costs completely when answering user queries, ignoring a 1,200-fold increase in wait time entirely. Together, our experiments reveal new challenges posed to LLMs as they navigate a dimension they cannot directly perceive, and highlight how their blind spots can even be simple cognitive abilities that humans take for granted.
articles.titleCn: 《追寻逝去的时光：大型语言模型的时间能力》
articles.abstractCn: 当今的大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地与时间互动：AI代理安排任务、与人及其他AI系统协调，甚至决定思考的时间长度。然而，LLMs只是间接地接触时间——通过描述而非体验。这是否阻碍了它们在涉及时间的推理和决策？我们的论文通过四个连续的评估，从模型的知识到其行为，追踪了这个问题。我们发现，模型知道时间的规则，这些规则可以被阅读，但难以预测必须体验的持续时间；尽管它们在由各种时间相关文献定理构建的问题集中表现出高度准确性（92.0-97.5%），却低估自身完成时间高达99.5%，并且无法识别哪些任务会花费更长时间运行。而且，尽管它们在估计人类任务持续时间方面表现更好，但其持续时间判断会根据事件措辞方式的变化而改变，甚至放大了高达1.3倍的相似人类偏见。从估计到行动，我们发现某些LLMs在回答用户查询时完全忽略时间成本，完全忽视了1200倍的等待时间增加。综合我们的实验表明，当LLMs在无法直接感知的维度中导航时，它们面临着新的挑战，并突显了它们的盲点甚至可能是一些人类视为理所当然的简单认知能力。

articles.title: Imperfectly Imperfect: Evaluating Graded Cognitive Diversity in LLM Persona Simulations
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as synthetic participants in social, behavioural, and decision-making research, yet it remains unclear whether they can express graded cognitive diversity as assigned when engaging in simulated behaviour. We introduce a cognition-suite evaluation that tests whether simulated populations reproduce human variation in reasoning, self-reported traits, their associations, and downstream behaviour. Agents conditioned on synthetic or human-derived profiles of cognitive reflection, Need for Cognition, and Big Five personality answer the same suite as a cohort of 473 adults: two newly assembled tests, a Cognitive Reflection Test (CRT) and a Behavioural Reflection Test (BRT) whose decision scenarios measure reflection in behaviour, alongside an established CRT and the two trait questionnaires. Across seven full-battery simulation runs of four models, agents recover Need for Cognition and Big Five trait distributions on self-report questionnaires, but fall short on simulating diversity of cognitive task performance and downstream behaviours. In the four Claude Sonnet 4.6 runs, every agent scores full marks on both CRTs, whatever reflection level its persona was assigned. In the other three runs agents make intuitive-lure errors (the tempting wrong answers CRT items invite), but 49 to 85% score full marks, against under 10% in the human sample. Claude Sonnet 5 comes closest to people's item-by-item pattern of lures; the other two runs give fewer lures and vary less between items. In the BRT scenarios, every run over-produces 8 to 11 of 15 coded behaviours by at least 20 percentage points, and people's links between reflection and behaviour carry over only in part. Useful synthetic populations must preserve not only trait descriptors but the structured variation in reasoning, error type, and behaviour those descriptors are meant to organise.
articles.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). 42 pages, 14 figures. Code: https://github.com/sion-w/CogSuite
articles.titleCn: 不完美的不完美：评估LLM角色模拟中的分级认知多样性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地被用作社会、行为和决策研究中的合成参与者，但尚不清楚它们在参与模拟行为时是否能表达所分配的分级认知多样性。我们引入了一套认知评估，用于测试模拟人群是否能重现人类的推理、自我报告特征、其关联以及下游行为的变化。基于认知反思、认知需求和大五人格的合成或人类衍生特征的代理，与473名成年人的队列回答相同的测试套件：两项新组装的测试——认知反思测试（CRT）和行为反思测试（BRT），其决策场景测量行为中的反思，以及一项已建立的CRT和两项特质问卷。在四个模型的七次完整电池模拟运行中，代理在自我报告问卷上恢复了认知需求和五大特质的分布，但在模拟认知任务表现和下游行为多样性方面有所欠缺。在四个Claude Sonnet 4.6运行中，每个代理在两项CRT上都获得满分，无论其角色被分配何种反思水平。在其他三次运行中，代理犯了直觉诱惑错误（CRT项目邀请的诱人错误答案），但49%至85%的代理获得满分，而人类样本中不到10%获得满分。Claude Sonnet 5最接近人类的逐项诱惑模式；其他两次运行提供的诱惑较少，项目之间的差异也较小。在BRT场景中，每次运行都至少以20个百分点的幅度过度产生15个编码行为中的8到11个，而人类在反思与行为之间的联系仅部分延续。有用的合成人群不仅要保留特质描述符，还要保留这些描述符旨在组织的推理、错误类型和行为中的结构化变化。

articles.title: Distinguishing Extraction Failures and Clinical Discordance with LLM Uncertainty on Radiology Reports
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can structure clinical datasets, but extraction error must be distinguished from discordance in the underlying data. From a real-world cohort of 1{,}045 patients undergoing coronary CT angiography (CCTA), we evaluated whether LLM uncertainty during vessel-level coronary artery disease (CAD) stenosis extraction could identify extraction failure and clinical discordance. References were expert CCTA annotations (253 patients) and subsequent invasive coronary angiography (ICA; 729 patients). We quantify extraction failure as disagreement between stenosis severity in LLM extracted versus expert annotations, and clinical discordance as disagreement in stenosis severity between CCTA and subsequent ICA. Stenosis Margin, selected from ten candidate measures, was used to quantify LLM uncertainty, and generalized estimating equation logistic regression and AUC evaluated its association and incremental discrimination for each failure mode. LLM uncertainty was strongly associated with extraction failure (adjusted OR 4.15 [95% CI 2.57--6.69], $P<0.001$) and substantially improved discrimination beyond LLM-extracted CCTA stenosis severity alone (AUC 0.81 to 0.86; $Δ$AUC $+0.06$ [$+0.03$, $+0.09$], $P=0.001$). In contrast, LLM uncertainty weakly associated with clinical discordance (adjusted OR 1.22 [1.04--1.43], Holm-adjusted $P=0.118$) but provided no incremental discrimination beyond LLM-extracted CCTA stenosis severity ($Δ$AUC $+0.01$ [$-0.00$, $+0.02$], $P=0.245$). Moreover, extraction errors and clinical discordance showed little overlap, with 38 of 42 clinically discordant vessels (90%) having been extracted correctly. LLM uncertainty may identify extraction failures without identifying underlying clinical discordance, supporting failure attribution when evaluating LLM-derived clinical datasets.
