articles.titleCn: 利用大型语言模型在放射学报告中的不确定性来区分提取失败和临床不一致
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）可以构建临床数据集，但必须将提取错误与基础数据中的不一致性区分开来。在一个包含1045名接受冠状动脉CT血管造影（CCTA）的真实世界队列中，我们评估了LLM在血管级冠状动脉疾病（CAD）狭窄提取过程中的不确定性是否能够识别提取失败和临床不一致性。参考标准为专家CCTA标注（253名患者）和随后的冠状动脉造影（ICA；729名患者）。我们将提取失败定义为LLM提取的狭窄严重程度与专家标注之间的不一致，临床不一致性定义为CCTA与后续ICA之间狭窄严重程度的不一致。从十个候选指标中选出的狭窄边缘（Stenosis Margin）用于量化LLM的不确定性，广义估计方程逻辑回归和AUC评估了其与每种失败模式的关联性和增量判别能力。LLM的不确定性强烈与提取失败相关（调整后的比值比为4.15 [95%置信区间2.57--6.69]，P<0.001），并且显著提高了除LLM提取的CCTA狭窄严重程度之外的判别能力（AUC从0.81提高到0.86；ΔAUC +0.06 [$+0.03$, +0.09]，P=0.001）。相比之下，LLM的不确定性仅与临床不一致性弱相关（调整后的比值比为1.22 [1.04--1.43]，Holm校正P=0.118），并且除LLM提取的CCTA狭窄严重程度之外未提供增量判别能力（ΔAUC +0.01 [$-0.00$, +0.02]，P=0.245）。此外，提取错误和临床不一致性几乎没有重叠，42根临床上不一致的血管中有38根（90%）被正确提取。LLM的不确定性可能识别提取失败而不识别潜在的临床不一致性，这支持在评估LLM生成的临床数据集时进行失败归因。

articles.title: Test-Time Scaling for Diffusion Language Models with Frequency-Aware Remasking
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, where decisions about which tokens to commit or remask strongly affect output quality. Existing certainty-aware strategies rely on instantaneous confidence or entropy, but these local signals can be misleading on difficult reasoning problems. We formulate DLM test-time scaling as adaptive allocation of both inference compute and decoding strategies. Our two-stage approach uses a fast base sampler to solve easy questions, then applies frequency-aware remasking to the remaining hard questions. This strategy tracks how often each token's prediction changes across denoising steps and preferentially commits frequently changing tokens, encouraging samples to explore alternative reasoning paths rather than collapse onto the model's preferred trajectory. Experiments with LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct show consistent improvements over a strong adaptive allocation baseline, with absolute accuracy gains of up to 3.73 percentage points (LLaDA) and 7.33 percentage points (Dream) on MATH-500, and absolute coverage gains of up to 11.39 percentage points (LLaDA) and 10.98 percentage points (Dream) on HumanEval. On questions unsolved by the base certainty-aware strategy after 100 samples, frequency-aware remasking recovers solutions for 3.75% to 18.75% of examples.
articles.titleCn: 频率感知重掩码的扩散语言模型的测试时缩放
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）通过迭代去噪生成文本，其中关于哪些标记应提交或重新掩码的决策会显著影响输出质量。现有的确定性感知策略依赖于瞬时置信度或熵，但这些局部信号在复杂的推理问题上可能具有误导性。我们将DLM测试时缩放问题表述为对推理计算和解码策略的适应性分配。我们的两阶段方法使用快速基础采样器解决简单问题，然后对剩余的难问题应用频率感知的重新掩码。该策略追踪每个标记的预测在去噪步骤中变化的频率，并优先提交频繁变化的标记，鼓励样本探索替代的推理路径，而不是收敛到模型的偏好轨迹。在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上的实验表明，与强大的自适应分配基线相比，我们的策略始终如一地取得了改进，在MATH-500上绝对准确率提升了高达3.73个百分点（LLaDA）和7.33个百分点（Dream），在HumanEval上绝对覆盖率提升了高达11.39个百分点（LLaDA）和10.98个百分点（Dream）。对于基础确定性感知策略在100个样本后仍未解决的问题，频率感知的重新掩码能够为3.75%至18.75%的示例恢复解决方案。

articles.title: Hibana: Fast Agentic Inference on Unified-Memory Devices
articles.abstract: Local AI promises capable personal assistants that run on users' own devices, keeping data and computation under their control. Open-weight models that fit on local devices can now handle practical tasks such as coding. Yet current inference engines fall short. Popular engines such as vLLM and SGLang target datacenter GPUs with dedicated host memory, while local engines underuse the memory hierarchy of unified-memory devices. We present Hibana, an inference engine for unified-memory devices that co-optimizes model representation, memory management, and decoding strategy. Model surgery, the process of editing a trained model's architecture to suit its hardware, changes how the model computes, shrinking its memory footprint and data movement. Unified-memory management preserves each agent's state across turns, so long-running agents can resume instantly instead of recomputing their state. Adaptive speculation generates several tokens per step. Hibana codesigns these features around the shared memory capacity and limited bandwidth of unified-memory systems-on-chip to support local multi-agent workloads. On a single DGX Spark serving Qwen and Nemotron models of up to 125B parameters, Hibana completes up to 3.4$\times$ more agentic tasks per hour and delivers up to 3.9$\times$ higher decoding throughput than other established frameworks such as vLLM, NVIDIA Flare, llama.cpp, and TensorFold. Code is available at https://github.com/sharar-project/hibana.
articles.titleCn: Hibana：统一内存设备上的快速智能推理
articles.abstractCn: 本地AI承诺在用户自己的设备上运行功能强大的个人助理，将数据和计算控制在用户手中。如今，适合本地设备的开放权重模型可以处理编码等实际任务。然而，当前的推理引擎存在不足。流行的引擎如vLLM和SGLang针对配备专用主机内存的数据中心GPU，而本地引擎未能充分利用统一内存设备的内存层次结构。我们提出了Hibana，这是一种针对统一内存设备的推理引擎，它协同优化模型表示、内存管理和解码策略。模型手术，即编辑训练模型的架构以适应其硬件的过程，改变了模型计算的方式，缩小了其内存占用和数据传输。统一内存管理在每个回合中保留每个代理的状态，因此长时间运行的代理可以立即恢复，而不是重新计算其状态。自适应推测每步生成多个标记。Hibana围绕统一内存系统的共享内存容量和有限带宽，协同设计这些功能，以支持本地多代理工作负载。在一台DGX Spark服务器上为参数量高达125B的Qwen和Nemotron模型提供服务时，Hibana每小时完成的代理任务最多可达其他成熟框架（如vLLM、NVIDIA Flare、llama.cpp和TensorFold）的3.4倍，解码吞吐量最高可达3.9倍。代码可在https://github.com/sharar-project/hibana获取。

articles.title: LongCapHarness: Capability-Guided Auto-Harnessing for Long-Context Reasoning
articles.abstract: Existing methods enhancing an LLM's long-context reasoning capability often rely on data synthesis and follow-up LLM post-training. However, the data synthesis strategy and the post-training recipes are empirically driven and computationally intensive. In this work, we propose a new framework, dubbed LongCapHarness, to instead harness the underlying capabilities for long-context reasoning. The harnessing process recursively revises and updates capability primitive implementation, capability state and control logic through recursive self-improvement on the development set. With neither data synthesis nor LLM post-training, LongCapHarness is applied to Llama3-8B and transferred to Qwen2.5-3B. LongCapHarness substantially outperforms recent data-synthesis-based baselines on HELMET and RULER benchmarks; its estimated development cost is less than 50% of the estimated training costs of NExtLong and PolicyLong. We hope these results motivate further research into harnessing the latent capabilities of LLMs to solve tasks beyond their explicit training.
articles.titleCn: 长上下文推理能力引导自动套接字技术
articles.abstractCn: 现有的增强大语言模型（LLM）长上下文推理能力的方法通常依赖于数据合成和后续的LLM后训练。然而，数据合成策略和后训练方法都是经验驱动的，并且计算密集。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的框架，称为LongCapHarness，以利用长上下文推理的潜在能力。利用过程通过在开发集上的递归自我改进，递归地修订和更新能力原语实现、能力状态和控制逻辑。LongCapHarness无需数据合成或LLM后训练，被应用于Llama3-8B并迁移到Qwen2.5-3B。LongCapHarness在HELMET和RULER基准测试中显著优于最近的数据合成基线；其估计的开发成本不到NExtLong和PolicyLong估计训练成本的50%。我们希望这些结果能够激励进一步研究利用LLM的潜在能力来解决其显式训练范围之外的任务。

articles.title: The Truth Beneath the Tokens: Prompt-Space Recovery of Knowledge Edits in Language Models
articles.abstract: Model editing provides an efficient way to update factual knowledge in transformer models. Recent approaches reverse edits by modifying, masking, or decomposing model weights, but make recovery dependent on weight-space interventions. We instead show that pre-edit knowledge can be recovered through input-space interventions alone, without modifying the edited model's weights. We introduce Memento, a prompt-space mechanism for auditing residual knowledge that learns a reusable recovery signal to steer an edited model toward its pre-edit response. Memento supports both continuous recovery prefixes and discrete textual prompts for standard text interfaces. Across three LLMs and five editing techniques, Memento recovers 80.07% of held-out edited facts, achieving a 9.58% relative improvement over baselines, suggesting that editing may suppress the facts without fully eliminating their recoverability. We further investigate whether prompt-space recovery extends beyond model editing. On pristine, unedited LLMs, Memento improves average factual recall by 53.9% relative to standard inference. These results demonstrate the potential of prompt-space recovery for auditing residual knowledge in edited models and investigating the gap between factual knowledge and its accessibility during inference. We will release our source code.
articles.titleCn: 符号之下的真相：语言模型中知识编辑的提示空间恢复
articles.abstractCn: 模型编辑为更新转换器模型中的事实性知识提供了一种高效方法。近期方法通过修改、掩码或分解模型权重来逆向编辑，但恢复过程依赖于权重空间的干预。我们则表明，仅通过输入空间的干预即可恢复预编辑知识，而无需修改已编辑模型的权重。我们引入了Memento，这是一种用于审计残存知识的提示空间机制，它学习可重用的恢复信号，以引导已编辑模型回归其预编辑响应。Memento支持连续恢复前缀和离散文本提示，适用于标准文本界面。在三个大型语言模型（LLM）和五种编辑技术中，Memento恢复了80.07%的已编辑事实，相较于基线实现了9.58%的相对提升，表明编辑可能抑制事实，但并未完全消除其可恢复性。我们进一步研究了提示空间恢复是否超出了模型编辑的范畴。在原始、未编辑的LLM上，Memento相较于标准推理将平均事实召回率提升了53.9%。这些结果表明，提示空间恢复在审计已编辑模型中的残存知识以及探究事实知识与推理时其可访问性之间的差距方面具有潜力。我们将发布我们的源代码。

articles.title: Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Interaction
articles.abstract: Self-evolving agents improve their own skills, memory, and harness code from experience without retraining the base LLM, and group-evolving agents go further by sharing these lessons across agents. Yet most such systems overlook that sharing across users and heterogeneous agents requires deciding who can benefit from each lesson and what information must remain private. We present MixUA, a memory system that distills independent user-agent trajectories into lessons and assigns each lesson to a user-agent pair, user, agent, or global scope according to whom it benefits and what it may disclose. For evaluation, we introduce CrossLearnBench, a mixed-user-agent benchmark that pairs established agent tasks with user preferences and privacy probes that test whether private facts leak into memory other users can read. With five users and seven agents, MixUA raises pass rates by up to 16 points over no memory and 5 over a single global memory, even on tasks previously tried only by other users on other agents. It retains up to 90% of previously stated preferences, and at most 0.02% of privacy probes find a planted private fact in a forbidden scope. We hope MixUA offers a scalable path toward a global system where users and agents co-evolve.
articles.titleCn: 谁记得什么？多粒度记忆提取用于多用户、多智能体交互
articles.abstractCn: 自我进化的智能体能够通过经验提升自身技能和记忆，并无需重新训练基础的大型语言模型来利用代码，而群体进化的智能体则更进一步，通过在智能体间共享这些经验教训。然而，大多数此类系统都忽略了跨用户和异构智能体的共享需要决定哪些用户或智能体可以从每条经验教训中受益，以及哪些信息必须保持私密。我们提出了MixUA，一个记忆系统，它将独立用户-智能体轨迹提炼为经验教训，并根据其受益对象和可能披露的信息，将每条经验教训分配给用户-智能体对、用户、智能体或全局范围。为了评估，我们引入了CrossLearnBench，一个混合用户-智能体基准，它将成熟的智能体任务与用户偏好和隐私探测相结合，以测试私人信息是否泄露到其他用户可以读取的记忆中。在五个用户和七个智能体的情况下，MixUA在不使用记忆的情况下提高了16个百分点的通过率，比单一全局记忆高出5个百分点，即使在之前仅由其他用户在其他智能体上尝试的任务中也是如此。它保留了高达90%的先前声明偏好，并且最多只有0.02%的隐私探测在禁止范围内发现了一个植入的私人事实。我们希望MixUA为用户提供了一条可扩展的路径，以实现一个用户和智能体共同进化的全球系统。

articles.title: Track or Follow? A Jev-Compatible Multi-Agent Trading System When Web News Lags the Market
articles.abstract: LLM agents increasingly trade on the Web news they read, yet much Web news about listed firms is published after, and about, the price move it reports, so a reader can agree with the market by following it instead of reading the event. We ask whether LLM judgments of Web news track the market's reaction to the reported event or follow it. To answer, we built a multi-agent trading system whose agents share only point-in-time stores and answer typed questions through the interface of Jev, a hosted typed decision model; code sets every position under a proved bound on how far text can move it. In a hash-committed test of a Jev-compatible reader built from a pinned LLM's option probabilities, item judgments track announcement-window abnormal returns (weekly Spearman 0.119), also after the LLM's release, and event types agree with the issuers' 8-K filings (AUC 0.833); Jev's judgments of news published after its own release track the reaction as well (descriptive). Exploratory analyses show where the association comes from: 72% of earnings news items appear after the issuer's filing, contributor-written items often report the price move, and from the first trade after publication the association falls to 0.023. At a weekly horizon, the confirmatory test detects no rank information over code-only features. Under attack, decision cards traced 88% of successful attacks to the planted item. We propose that market-graded tests of Web-text readers report the criterion from publication, not only from the event.
articles.titleCn: 追踪还是跟随？当网络新闻落后于市场时，一个与杰文兼容的多智能体交易系统
articles.abstractCn: LLM智能体越来越多地在网络上交易它们所阅读的新闻，然而许多关于上市公司的网络新闻是在其报道的价格变动之后发布的，因此读者可以通过跟随新闻来认同市场，而不是阅读事件本身。我们探究LLM对网络新闻的判断是否追踪了市场对所报道事件的反应，还是仅仅跟随其发布。为此，我们构建了一个多智能体交易系统，其中智能体仅共享即时状态存储，并通过Jev（一个托管型类型化决策模型）的界面回答类型化问题；代码确保每个头寸都在文本可能移动它的距离的证明界限内。在一个基于已固定LLM期权概率的Jev兼容型读者哈希提交测试中，项目判断追踪了公告窗口的异常回报（每周Spearman相关系数0.119），即使在LLM发布之后也是如此；事件类型与发行人的8-K文件一致（AUC 0.833）；Jev对其发布后的新闻的判断也追踪了同样的反应（描述性）。探索性分析表明这种关联的来源：72%的盈利新闻项目出现在发行人文件之后，贡献者撰写的内容经常报道价格变动，并且从发布后的第一笔交易开始，关联性降至0.023。在每周的时间范围内，确认性测试未检测到代码特征之外的排名信息。在攻击下，决策卡追踪了88%的成功攻击到植入项目的来源。我们提出，网络文本读者的市场评级测试应报告发布标准，而不仅仅是事件标准。

articles.title: Coding or Cheating? An Investigation of Frontier Coding LLMs
articles.abstract: Frontier agentic LLMs are trained on verifiable rewards in reinforcement learning (RL) environments built from real software repositories. A passing test suite is treated as the reward for solving the task. We show that, on hard problems, frontier models often satisfy these rewards by obtaining the answer instead of deriving it, known as reward hacking. Prior reports document this behavior on public benchmarks. We test its persistence on unseen problems. In a hardened environment where the answer cannot leak, nearly every model we tested attempted to recover the answer, escalating through tiers of increasingly specialized exploitation: mining the repository history for the upstream fix, inspecting the git object store directly, and sweeping the filesystem for a possible newer copy of the source or hidden tests. These attempts were concentrated on the hardest problems, and the models differed in whether, how often, and how deeply they escalated. Our position is that this behavior is a learned shortcut, acquired in RL environments that leak the answer, not a sign of intelligence. We release agent traces for these models to support further study at https://huggingface.co/datasets/logitly-ai/reward-hacking-raw-v1.
articles.titleCn: 编程还是作弊？一项关于前沿编程大型语言模型的研究
articles.abstractCn: 前沿的代理式大型语言模型（LLMs）在基于真实软件仓库构建的强化学习（RL）环境中，通过可验证的奖励进行训练。通过通过测试套件来完成任务被视为奖励。我们证明，在难题上，前沿模型往往通过直接获取答案而非推导答案来满足这些奖励，这种现象被称为奖励劫持。之前的报告记录了这种行为在公开基准上的表现。我们测试了其在未见问题上的持续性。在一个答案无法泄露的强化环境中，我们测试的几乎所有模型都试图恢复答案，并通过越来越专业的利用层次进行升级：挖掘仓库历史记录以寻找上游修复、直接检查git对象存储，以及扫描文件系统以寻找可能的更新版本源代码或隐藏测试。这些尝试集中在最难的问题上，模型在是否、频率以及深度上升级方面存在差异。我们的观点是，这种行为是在答案泄露的强化环境中习得的捷径，而非智能的体现。我们发布了这些模型的代理追踪记录，以支持进一步研究，具体可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/logitly-ai/reward-hacking-raw-v1 获取。

articles.title: FEROM: Frontier Endogenous Reveal-Order Marginal Policy Optimization for Masked Diffusion LMs
articles.abstract: Masked diffusion language models generate text by iteratively unmasking positions, with practical samplers often selecting reveal positions from the model's own logits. The reveal order is therefore an endogenous latent variable of the rollout process with an enormous discrete latent space. Policy optimization objectives relying on pre-defined schedules or sampled trajectories introduce either bias or high variance. In this paper, we propose FEROM, Frontier Endogenous Reveal-Order Marginal Policy Optimization, which approximates policy gradients for the rollout-induced marginal response policy of masked diffusion LMs. FEROM derives a Rao-Blackwellized policy-gradient identity over latent reveal orders and expresses the resulting estimator as posterior edge occupancy on a reveal-state DAG. To make marginalization practical, we introduce Frontier Reveal Marginalization, a budgeted estimator that approximates this marginal edge structure by combining CDF-based computation of local probabilities of the endogenous reveal process with frontier expansion of high-mass partial states. Integrated into a GRPO-style objective, FEROM replaces single-path log-scores with a detached token-score surrogate over posterior-relevant reveal edges. Experiments on math and coding tasks show comparable or improved results over existing methods under matched scoring-state budgets. An offline proxy study further shows improved marginal-gradient approximation with increased scoring budgets.
articles.titleCn: FEROM：面向掩码扩散语言模型的边界内生揭示顺序边缘策略优化
articles.abstractCn: 掩码扩散语言模型通过迭代地解掩码位置来生成文本，实际采样器通常从模型的自身logits中选择揭示位置。因此，揭示顺序是展开过程中一个内生的潜变量，具有巨大的离散潜空间。依赖预定义调度或采样轨迹的政策优化目标会引入偏差或高方差。在本文中，我们提出了FEROM，即前沿内生揭示顺序边缘政策优化，它近似了掩码扩散LM展开诱导的边缘响应策略的政策梯度。FEROM在潜揭示顺序上推导出Rao-Blackwell化政策梯度恒等式，并将结果估计器表示为揭示状态DAG上的后验边缘占用。为了使边缘化实用化，我们引入了前沿揭示边缘化，这是一种预算估计器，通过结合基于CDF的内生揭示过程的局部概率计算与高质部分状态的前沿扩展来近似这种边缘结构。集成到GRPO风格的目标中，FEROM用后验相关揭示边缘上的脱离标记分数替代了单路径log分数。在数学和编码任务上的实验表明，在匹配评分状态预算下，与现有方法相比，FEROM取得了相当或更好的结果。一个离线代理研究进一步表明，随着评分预算的增加，边缘梯度近似得到了改善。

articles.title: SituRecBench: Evaluating Frontier Models as Situated Recommendation Assistants in 3D Environments
articles.abstract: Recommender systems are transitioning from static retrieval engines into interactive assistants grounded in physical environments. However, current studies largely neglect the combined complexities of spatial navigation, visual grounding, and multi-turn social interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce SituRecBench, an interactive benchmark for evaluating frontier vision-language models (VLMs) as situated recommendation assistants within high-fidelity 3D environments. We reformulate recommendation as a situated assistance process in which an assistant interacts with a user while sharing the user's egocentric view. Our benchmark simulates real-world shopping environments (e.g., supermarkets and home furnishings stores), requiring assistants to elicit preferences, ground recommendations in the environment, and guide the user to relevant locations through dialogue. The benchmark evaluates dialogue quality, recommendation utility, and navigation effectiveness through a unified interactive protocol. Extensive experiments reveal persistent challenges in spatial grounding and preference elicitation, highlighting limitations in their ability to integrate global contextual information with local observations. SituRecBench provides a rigorous foundation for advancing the development of situated assistants in the real world.

articles.titleCn: SituRecBench：评估前沿模型作为3D环境中的情境推荐助手
articles.abstractCn: 推荐系统正从静态检索引擎转变为基于物理环境的交互式助手。然而，当前研究在很大程度上忽视了空间导航、视觉基础和多轮社交交互的综合复杂性。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了SituRecBench，这是一个用于评估前沿视觉语言模型（VLMs）作为高保真3D环境中的情境推荐助手的交互式基准。我们将推荐重新定义为一种情境辅助过程，其中助手在与用户互动时共享用户的视点。我们的基准模拟了现实世界的购物环境（例如超市和家居用品店），要求助手通过对话引出用户偏好、在环境中进行推荐，并引导用户前往相关地点。该基准通过统一的交互协议评估对话质量、推荐效用和导航效果。大量实验揭示了空间基础和偏好引出方面的持续挑战，突显了它们整合全局上下文信息与局部观察的能力局限性。SituRecBench为推进现实世界中情境助手的发展提供了严谨的基础。

articles.title: Collaboration Signatures: Tracking Long-Horizon Dynamics of Cross-Meeting Collaboration Networks
articles.abstract: Enterprise platforms have received increasing attention as a core component of social networks and the Web. However, existing work mostly relies on fragmented logs of small units of work, like emails and chats, and focuses on who connects with whom without sufficient account of collaboration content and dynamics. This work systematically explores tracking collaborations across sequences of meetings as a new approach to interpreting their long-horizon dynamics. Linking 45,426 meetings in a large multinational technology company based on full transcripts and 1.6 million extracted agenda items, we establish a cross-meeting collaboration network of 6,065 collaborations. The network recovers the natural shapes of workplace collaborations: meetings, as snapshots of ongoing collaboration, link into largely tree-shaped structures, while the work content forms nested directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). Further, we explore how these networks evolve over time, examining three established perspectives: task division, team composition, and temporal continuity. Each explains part of the dynamics but does not capture the distinctness of long-horizon workplace collaboration: e.g., work flows in a consistent direction between a few pairs of subjects, yet a collaboration's subject explains little of how its meetings are conducted. Instead, accumulating the agenda, interaction, and language of meetings along each tree yields a signature of the collaboration, a distinctive profile that picks out the collaboration of a held-out meeting at 4.5 times chance. The signature models collaboration better than team or task views, individually or combined, in next-meeting prediction and tree-level fitting. We discuss the implications of these cross-meeting dynamics for designing office applications and support tools, and call for next-generation Web systems that represent collaborations over their long horizon.
articles.titleCn: 合作签名：追踪跨会议合作网络的长期动态
articles.abstractCn: 企业平台作为社交网络和互联网的核心组成部分，正受到越来越多的关注。然而，现有研究大多依赖于小型工作单元（如邮件和聊天）的碎片化日志，并侧重于分析人与人之间的连接关系，而未能充分考虑到协作内容和动态。本研究系统地探索了通过会议序列追踪协作关系，将其作为解释长期动态的新方法。基于一家大型跨国科技公司完整的会议记录和160万项提取的议程事项，我们构建了一个包含6065项协作关系的跨会议协作网络。该网络恢复了工作场所协作的自然形态：作为协作过程的快照，会议链接成以树形结构为主的网络，而工作内容则形成嵌套的有向无环图（DAG）。此外，我们探讨了这些网络随时间演变的规律，考察了三个既定视角：任务分工、团队构成和时序连续性。每个视角都解释了部分动态，但未能捕捉长期工作协作的独特性，例如，少数主体之间形成一致的工作流向，而协作主题却很少解释其会议的开展方式。相反，通过积累每棵树中的会议议程、互动和语言，我们得到了协作的“签名”——一个独特的特征，能够以4.5倍于偶然性的概率识别出未参与会议的协作。在会议预测和树级拟合方面，该签名比团队或任务视角单独或结合使用时更能准确模拟协作。我们讨论了这些跨会议动态对设计办公应用和支持工具的意义，并呼吁下一代互联网系统能够展现协作的长期动态。

articles.title: Two-Sided Conformal Evidence Sets for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can surface passages that support a claim, contradict it, or fail to address it, yet existing calibrated grounding methods are typically one-sided and model only supporting evidence. We introduce Conformal Evidence Sets (CES), a two-sided framework that returns separate support and refutation sets with finite-sample inclusion coverage of at least $1-α$ on each side under exchangeability; a Bonferroni union yields joint coverage of at least $1-2α$. On labeled candidate pools from the contrastive VitaminC benchmark, CES closely tracks nominal coverage across $α\!\in\!\{0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.30\}$, with maximum deviations of $3.0$ percentage points for support and $5.4$ for refutation, and reaches essentially the same empirical coverage--size frontier as a test-tuned fixed-threshold heuristic without any test exposure. Stress tests mark the boundary of that guarantee: under FEVER distribution shift both sides under-cover, by up to $12.7$ percentage points, and support-side group-stratified recalibration substantially reduces the support gap. Scorer swaps, hard-negative retrieval, cross-dataset transfer, and a live end-to-end pilot expose a clear separation: when exchangeability holds and relevant evidence is retrieved, evidence inclusion remains calibrated even with an imperfect scorer, whereas the support/refute verdict tracks scorer quality directly. Calibrated evidence coverage and reliable verdicts are therefore distinct properties and should be reported separately.

articles.titleCn: 检索增强生成中的双边共形证据集
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）能够揭示支持论点的段落、反驳论点的段落或未涉及论点的段落，但现有的校准接地方法通常具有片面性，仅模型支持性证据。我们引入了符合性证据集（CES），这是一个双向框架，在可交换性下，每侧都返回独立的支撑和反驳集，并具有至少$1-α$的有限样本包含覆盖；Bonferroni并集产生至少$1-2α$的联合覆盖。在对比维生素C基准的标记候选集中，CES在$α\!\in\!\{0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.30\}$范围内紧密追踪名义覆盖，支撑和反驳的最大偏差分别为3.0和5.4个百分点，并达到与测试调优的固定阈值启发式方法基本相同的经验覆盖-规模前沿，且无需任何测试曝光。压力测试标明了该保证的边界：在FEVER分布偏移下，两侧均存在覆盖不足，最高偏差达12.7个百分点，而支撑侧的组分层校准显著减少了支撑差距。评分器交换、硬负样本检索、跨数据集迁移以及实时端到端试点揭示了一个明确分离：当可交换性成立且检索到相关证据时，即使评分器不完美，证据包含仍保持校准，而支撑/反驳的判定直接反映评分器质量。因此，校准证据覆盖和可靠判定是不同的属性，应分别报告。
